full_article:
By A Staff Reporter, Kathmandu, Aug. 23: The Nepali Congress is facing a serious internal test, with party President Gagan Kumar Thapa’s leadership pushing ahead with the party’s 15th General Convention while the faction led by former president Sher Bahadur Deuba continues to challenge the legitimacy of the process.

The dispute, which began with the Special General Convention, has now moved beyond a contest over leadership. It has become a wider debate over the future direction of Nepal’s oldest democratic party, with questions of party unity, internal democracy, the authority to convene the general convention and the role of the judiciary all converging.

The Election Commission and Supreme Court have recognised the leadership that emerged from the Special General Convention.

However, the Supreme Court has since agreed to review its earlier decision following petitions filed by Deuba and former acting president Purna Bahadur Khadka, keeping the leadership dispute alive.

Deuba, who returned to Nepal after five months’ stay abroad for treatment, has brought confidence to his faction, seeking legitimization of previous central committee.

However, the Nepali Congress Central Working Committee has fixed the 15th General Convention for October 2-5 and is moving ahead with preparations. They argue that the special general convention reflected the demand for change from a majority of party representatives and that the party cannot return to its previous leadership arrangement.

Nepali Congress spokesperson Devraj Chalise said the current rift was largely the result of some leaders refusing to accept the demand for change from party cadres and the public.

“The current rift is just the making of some leaders who cannot bear with the fact that the cadres and public want change within the largest democratic party of Nepal,” said Chalise.

He said the political environment following the Gen Z movement had forced the Nepali Congress to reconsider its organisation and relationship with voters.

“After the Gen Z movement, Nepali Congress saw that it needed to have a reform within itself to be closer to the public and understand public’s mandate,” he said.

Chalise maintained that more than 50 per cent of party representatives had supported the demand for the Special General Convention and that both the Election Commission and Supreme Court had already legitimised the process.

“Even after all this, instead of uniting the party, some people within the party are trying to cause inter-party rift,” he said.

He said the party should now focus on the convention already announced.

“Party convention has already been announced and it will go on according to the schedule. The only way forward is to understand that the convention will happen and the decision made from that convention will be the way forward for the party,” said Chalise.

The establishment faction has sought to portray the coming convention as an opportunity for organisational renewal rather than merely another leadership contest.

The Deuba faction, however, remains firmly opposed to the special general convention and argues that it was conducted outside the authority provided by the party statute.

Min Bahadur Bishwakarma, a leader of the Deuba faction, said the dispute had to be viewed against the political turmoil surrounding the Gen Z movement.

“The Gen Z movement saw much infrastructure destruction. The party offices of political parties were burned down. So many casualties took place. And our leader Sher Bahadur Deuba was attacked and injured,” said Bishwakarma.

He said the unrest had put the constitution and national sovereignty under serious pressure. “The constitution and the sovereignty of the country were put in danger and it still is in danger. So many institutions have been damaged,” he said.

Bishwakarma argued that, instead of bringing the party together

during such a difficult period, some leaders moved towards a special general convention.

“During these kinds of times, some leaders within the party, instead of uniting and moving forward, called for special convention,” he said.

He rejected the legality of the special general convention and maintained that the central working committee under Deuba should have remained responsible for organising the party’s regular convention.

“The special convention, how it was done and how it took place is not legal according to the party statute. It is totally illegal. The only way forward was via party convention called by then central committee members under Sher Bahadur Deuba.

But that was overridden illegally via special convention,” said Bishwakarma.

The Supreme Court’s decision to review its earlier ruling has provided the Deuba faction with renewed grounds to pursue its legal challenge. However, the decision to review the case does not itself overturn the existing recognition of the Thapa-led leadership.

Despite the differences, Bishwakarma said he did not want the dispute to result in a permanent split.

“As per unification or breaking the party, I am always for unification. This historic party has a part to play in Nepali politics. It has a role to play in saving the country's constitution and sovereignty,” he said.

He said his faction would accept the outcome of a convention it considers legally constituted.

“When the legal party convention will take place and new representatives will be elected, we will all agree to the result. But for now, we will fight for what is right,” said Bishwakarma.

The position reflects the central contradiction facing the Nepali Congress. Both factions speak of unity, but they disagree fundamentally over the organisational process through which that unity should be achieved.

The Deuba faction has also held a separate national gathering, where its leaders rejected the special general convention and called for a unified 15th General Convention. The Thapa faction, however, has rejected the authority of such a parallel gathering to determine official party policy.

Amid the confrontation, general secretary Pradip Paudel has emerged as a voice for reconciliation. In an appeal to party leaders and cadres, Paudel warned that the Nepali Congress could not afford to remain consumed by its internal dispute while the country was facing political uncertainty.

“The Nepali Congress is not just a political party, it is a democratic movement that carries the trust of the common Nepali people, the carrier of rights, and the dream of the country's prosperity,” Paudel wrote via social media.

He said the events surrounding the Gen Z movement and their aftermath had left the country at a difficult juncture and urged the party to look beyond its

internal troubles.

“If the Nepali Congress itself is not vigilant and strong in such critical times, the country is at risk of falling into a whirlpool of major political chaos,” he added.

Paudel appealed to both factions to resolve their differences through dialogue rather than prolonged legal and organisational confrontation.

“This is not the time to take our internal disagreements to the streets or wait at the courthouse. I think that the Nepali Congress dispute is not and should not be a matter for the courts to resolve. Political issues can only be resolved through political dialogue,” he added.

He urged dissatisfied leaders and workers to return to the party headquarters in Sanepa for talks.

“Let us sit in Sanepa and have a dialogue. Let us accept the leadership that will be handed over by the common workers by holding the upcoming 15th General Convention on time and embark on the path of further strengthening democracy together,” he added.

For the Thapa faction, the challenge is to ensure that the October convention is sufficiently broad and credible to bring the dissident camp back into the mainstream. Thapa has indicated that he is willing to address concerns over membership and the fairness of the convention process.

For the Deuba faction, the immediate priority remains securing recognition of what it considers the legitimate organisational structure before accepting the convention process.

एक स्टाफ रिपोर्टर, काठमांडू, 23 अगस्त : नेपाली कांग्रेस के गंभीर आतंरिक परीक्षा के सामना करय पड़ि रहल अछि, पार्टी के अध्यक्ष गगन कुमार थापा के नेतृत्व पार्टी के 15म आम अधिवेशन के आगू बढ़ा रहल अछि जखन कि पूर्व अध्यक्ष शेरबहादुर देउबा के नेतृत्व वाला गुट एहि प्रक्रिया के वैधता के चुनौती देबय के काज जारी अछि.

विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन स शुरू भेल विवाद आब नेतृत्व क मुकाबला स आगू बढ़ि गेल अछि। नेपाल केरऽ सबसें पुरानऽ लोकतांत्रिक दल केरऽ भविष्य केरऽ दिशा प॑ ई एगो व्यापक बहस बनी गेलऽ छै, जेकरा म॑ पार्टी एकता, आतंरिक लोकतंत्र, सामान्य अधिवेशन केरऽ आह्वान करै के अधिकार आरू न्यायपालिका के भूमिका के सवाल सब एकजुट होय गेलऽ छै ।

चुनाव आयोग आ सर्वोच्च न्यायालय विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन स निकलल नेतृत्व कए मान्यता देलक अछि।

लेकिन एकरऽ बाद सुप्रीम कोर्ट देउबा आरू पूर्व कार्यवाहक अध्यक्ष पूर्णबहादुर खड्का केरऽ याचिका के बाद अपनऽ पूर्व फैसला के समीक्षा करै प॑ सहमत होय गेलऽ छै, जेकरा स॑ नेतृत्व विवाद क॑ जिंदा रखलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

पांच मासक विदेश मे रहला के बाद इलाज के लेल नेपाल वापस आयल देउवा अपन गुट के विश्वास दिला देलखिन्ह, जे पिछला केन्द्रीय समिति के वैधता देबय के मांग केलखिन्ह.

मुदा नेपाली काँग्रेस केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति १५अम सामान्य अधिवेशन २-५ अक्टुबरके लेल तय कएने अछि आ तैयारीमे आगा बढि रहल अछि । हुनकऽ तर्क छै कि विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन म॑ पार्टी केरऽ बहुमत के प्रतिनिधि स॑ बदलाव के मांग के झलक मिललै आरू पार्टी अपनऽ पूर्व नेतृत्व व्यवस्था प॑ वापस नै आबी सकै छै ।

नेपाली कांग्रेस प्रवक्ता देवराज चालीसे वर्तमान दरार बहुत हद तक पार्टी कार्यकर्ता आ जनता स परिवर्तन के मांग के किछु नेता स्वीकार करय स मना करय के परिणाम रहल बतौलनि ।

चालीसे कहलनि जे, वर्तमान दरार मात्र किछु एहन नेता के बनाबय के अछि जे ई बात के सहन नहि क सकैत छथि जे कार्यकर्ता आ जनता नेपाल के सबस पैघ लोकतांत्रिक पार्टी के भीतर परिवर्तन चाहैत अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन के बाद राजनीतिक परिवेश नेपाली कांग्रेस के अपन संगठन आ मतदाता के संग संबंध पर पुनर्विचार करय लेल बाध्य केलक अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन के बाद नेपाली कांग्रेस देखलक जे जनता के नजदीक रहय आ जनता के जनादेश के बुझय लेल ओकरा अपना भीतर सुधार के जरूरत अछि।

चालीसे के कहना छै कि पार्टी के 50 प्रतिशत स॑ अधिक प्रतिनिधि न॑ विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के मांग के समर्थन करलकै आरू चुनाव आयोग आरू सुप्रीम कोर्ट दोनों ही ई प्रक्रिया क॑ वैध बना चुकलऽ छै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, एहि सब के बादो पार्टी के एकजुट करय के बजाय पार्टी के भीतर के किछ लोक अंतरदलीय दरार पैदा करय के कोशिश मे लागल छथिन्ह.

ओ कहला जे आब पार्टी कए पहिने स घोषित अधिवेशन पर ध्यान देबाक चाही।

चालीसे कहलनि जे, पार्टी अधिवेशन के घोषणा भ चुकल अछि आ कार्यक्रम के अनुसार चलत, आगू के एकमात्र रास्ता इ बुझब अछि जे अधिवेशन होयत आ ओहि अधिवेशन स जे निर्णय लेल जायत ओ पार्टी के लेल आगू के रास्ता होयत।

स्थापना गुट न॑ आबै वाला अधिवेशन क॑ खाली एगो आरू नेतृत्व मुकाबला के बजाय संगठनात्मक नवीकरण के अवसर के रूप म॑ पेश करै के कोशिश करलकै ।

देउबा गुट, लेकिन विशेष सामान्य सम्मेलन के दृढ़ विरोध करी रहलऽ छै आरू ओकरऽ तर्क छै कि ई पार्टी के विधान द्वारा उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ गेलऽ अधिकार स॑ बाहर करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

देउबा गुटके नेता मिन बहादुर विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन के घेरने राजनीतिक उथल-पुथल के विरुद्ध विवाद के देखय पड़ल अछि।

विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, जेन जेड आन्दोलन मे बुनियादी ढांचा के बहुत तबाही देखल गेल।राजनीतिक दल के पार्टी कार्यालय जरि गेल।एतेक जानमाल के नुकसान भेल।आ हमर नेता शेरबहादुर देउबा पर हमला भ घायल भ गेल।

ओ कहलनि जे, अशांति के कारण संविधान आ राष्ट्रीय संप्रभुता पर गंभीर दबाव आबि गेल अछि। ओ कहलनि जे, संविधान आ देशक संप्रभुता खतरा मे पड़ल आ एखनो खतरा मे अछि, एतेक संस्था के नुकसान पहुंचल अछि।

विश्वकर्मा के तर्क छल जे, पार्टी के एक ठाम लाबय के बजाय

एहन कठिन अवधि मे किछु नेता विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन दिस बढ़लाह ।

ओ कहलनि जे, एहि तरहक समय मे पार्टी के भीतर किछु नेता एकजुट भ आगू बढ़बाक बदला विशेष अधिवेशन के आह्वान केलनि।

ओ विशेष सामान्य अधिवेशन के वैधता के खारिज करैत कहलनि जे, पार्टी के नियमित अधिवेशन के आयोजन के जिम्मेदारी देउबा के अधीन केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति के रहबाक चाही छल.

ओ कहलनि जे, विशेष अधिवेशन, कोना भेल आ कोना भेल से पार्टी के विधान के अनुसार कानूनी नहि अछि, ई एकदम गैरकानूनी अछि, आगू बढ़बाक एकमात्र रास्ता छल शेरबहादुर देउबा के तहत तत्कालीन केन्द्रीय समिति सदस्य द्वारा बजाओल गेल पार्टी अधिवेशन के माध्यम स।

मुदा ओहि बात कए विशेष अधिवेशन क माध्यम स गैरकानूनी तरीका स ओवरराइड क देल गेल।Ó विश्वकर्मा कहला।

सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ अपनऽ पहलऽ फैसला के समीक्षा करै के फैसला स॑ देउबा गुट क॑ अपनऽ कानूनी चुनौती के आगे बढ़ाबै के नयका आधार मिललऽ छै । मुदा, मामलाक समीक्षा करबाक निर्णय स्वयं थापा नेतृत्वक नेतृत्वक विद्यमान मान्यता केँ पलटि नहि दैत अछि ।

मतभेदक बादो विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, ओ नहि चाहैत छथि जे एहि विवादक परिणाम स्थायी रूप सँ विभाजन हो।

ओ कहलनि जे, एकीकरण या पार्टी तोड़बाक अनुसार हम सदिखन एकीकरण के पक्ष मे छी, नेपाली राजनीति मे एहि ऐतिहासिक पार्टी के भूमिका अछि, देश के संविधान आ संप्रभुता के बचाबय मे एकर भूमिका अछि।

ओ कहलनि जे, हुनकर गुट कानूनी तौर पर गठित मानल गेल अधिवेशन के परिणाम स्वीकार करत।

विश्वकर्मा कहलनि जे, जखन कानूनी पार्टीक अधिवेशन होयत आ नव प्रतिनिधि चुनल जायत तखन हम सब परिणाम पर सहमत होयब, मुदा फिलहाल हम सब जे सही अछि ओकरा लेल लड़ब।

ई स्थिति नेपाली कांग्रेस के सामने केन्द्रीय विरोधाभास के दर्शाबैत अछि । दुनू गुट एकता के बात करै छै, लेकिन संगठनात्मक प्रक्रिया पर मौलिक रूप स॑ असहमत छै, जेकरा माध्यम स॑ वू एकता प्राप्त करलऽ जाय ।

देउबा गुट अलग राष्ट्रीय सभा सेहो केने अछि, जाहि मे ओकर नेता विशेष आम अधिवेशन के खारिज क एकीकृत 15म महाधिवेशन के आह्वान केलक अछि। थापा गुट तथापि पार्टीक आधिकारिक नीति निर्धारित करबाक लेल एहन समानांतर सभाक अधिकार केँ खारिज क’ देलक अछि ।

मुठभेड़ के बीच महासचिव प्रदीप पौडेल सुलह के आवाज के रूप में उभरल छैथ। पार्टी के नेता कार्यकर्ता सब के अपील में पौडेल नेपाली कांग्रेस अपन आतंरिक विवाद स भस्म भ गेल रहय के सामर्थ्य नै राखि सकैत अछि, जखन कि देश राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता के सामना करय पड़ि रहल अछि, चेतावनी देलनि।

‘नेपाली कांग्रेस खाली राजनीतिक दल नै छै, ई एगो लोकतान्त्रिक आन्दोलन छै जे आम नेपाली जनता के विश्वास, अधिकार के वाहक, आरू देश के समृद्धि के सपना के वाहक छै ।’’ पौडेल सोशल मीडिया के माध्यम स॑ लिखलकै ।

ओ कहलनि जे जेन जेड आंदोलन आ ओकर बाद के घटनाक्रम देश के कठिन मोड़ पर छोड़ि देलक अछि आ पार्टी सं आग्रह केलनि जे ओ अपन सं आगू देखय

आंतरिक परेशानी।

ओ आगू कहलनि जे, एहन गंभीर समय मे यदि नेपाली कांग्रेस स्वयं सतर्क आ मजबूत नहि अछि त देश पैघ राजनीतिक अराजकता के भंवर मे पड़बाक खतरा अछि।

पौडेल न॑ दूनू गुट स॑ अपील करलकै कि लम्बा समय तलक कानूनी आरू संगठनात्मक मुठभेड़ के बजाय बातचीत के माध्यम स॑ अपनऽ मतभेद के समाधान करलऽ जाय ।

ओ आगू कहलनि जे, ई समय नहि अछि जे हम अपन आन्तरिक असहमति के सड़क पर ल जेबाक या कोर्ट हाउस मे इंतजार करी, हमरा लगैत अछि जे नेपाली कांग्रेस के विवाद न्यायालय के समाधान के मामला नहि अछि आ नहि हेबाक चाही, राजनीतिक मुद्दा राजनीतिक मुद्दा के समाधान मात्र राजनीतिक संवाद स भ सकैत अछि।

ओ असंतुष्ट नेता आ कार्यकर्ता सब सनेपा स्थित पार्टी मुख्यालय मे वार्ता क लेल वापस आबय लेल आग्रह केलथि।

ओ आगू कहलनि जे, सनेपा मे बैसि कए संवाद करी, आगामी 15म महाधिवेशन कए समय पर आयोजित कए आम कार्यकर्ता द्वारा जे नेतृत्व सौंपल जाएत ओकरा स्वीकार करि लोकतंत्र कए आओर मजबूत करबाक बाट पर एक संग आबि जाउ।

थापा गुट के लेलऽ चुनौती ई छै कि अक्टूबर केरऽ अधिवेशन एतना व्यापक आरू विश्वसनीय होय ताकि असहमत खेमा क॑ फेर स॑ मुख्यधारा म॑ लानलऽ जाय सक॑ । थापा सदस्यता आ अधिवेशन प्रक्रिया के निष्पक्षता के बारे में चिंता के समाधान करय लेल तैयार रहय के संकेत देलखिन्ह.

देउबा गुट के लेलऽ तत्काल प्राथमिकता बनलऽ छै कि अधिवेशन प्रक्रिया क॑ स्वीकार करै स॑ पहल॑ वू जेकरा वैध संगठनात्मक संरचना मान॑ छै, ओकरा मान्यता सुरक्षित करलऽ जाय ।

publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
In 1937, The Modern Review (India) published an article titled The Rashtrapati written under the pseudonym Chanakya. It was written against the backdrop of rising strongmen in European states—Hitler in Germany, Stalin in Russia, and Mussolini in Italy. Chanakya is critical of Jawaharlal Nehru, whose popularity was rising among the Indian populace and the cadres of the Indian National Congress. The article was an early warning against the hero-worship of politicians and about how such behaviour from the citizenry, seeking a saviour, could jeopardise democracy. Chanakya recognises this peril and writes, “Therein lies the danger for Jawaharlal and for India.”

A new democracy like Nepal could also succumb to such a threat when personality cults are welcomed with adulation while dissent against deified political leaders is met with severe derision and cyberbullying. In a democracy, when citizens seek salvation from only one individual, it could undermine the distribution of power among public authorities.

In the aftermath of the Gen Z uprising of September, the Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) secured a near two-thirds majority in March’s snap polls, instating Balendra ‘Balen’ Shah. The protests voiced a rejection of the older political parties, given their repeated failures to deliver, poor governance, sycophancy, economic stagnation, and corruption. The election slogan, Ab ki bar Balen sarkar and the RSP campaign were somewhat fixated on Balen’s popularity and on placing him in the prime minister’s chair.

Despite receiving an overwhelming mandate, the incumbent’s modus operandi has been called into question in terms of parliamentary processes, issuing ordinances, dealing with a constitutional body and at the diplomatic level.

Recently, the prime minister’s advisors summoned the chief and officials from the Commission for the Investigation of Abuse of Authority (CIAA) and rebuked them over delays in an investigation, showcasing an overreach while undermining the independence of constitutional bodies. The operating style is further plagued by provocative statements. For instance, during his speech at the RSP general convention, he mentioned, “If required, we will consult with the CIAA not just for five hours but for five years.” The ad hoc behaviours of walking out of the parliament mid-session and reprimanding the head of a constitutional body do not bode well for a young democracy.

In a democracy, leaders matter, but lasting institutions matter more. Benjamin Jones and Benjamin Olken, in their paper, ‘Do Leaders Matter? National Leadership and Growth since WWII’, investigate whether leaders have an impact on the growth of the country. The article concludes that institutions play a bigger role than an individual leader in a democracy. It is not that countries like Nepal do not require strong leadership. But more than good leaders, they need strong institutions and branches of government that can maintain checks and balances against any form of executive overreach.

However, the graver threat to democracy emerges from the citizenry’s inability to question their leader, yielding to personality cults. When citizens turn leaders into messiahs, supporters struggle to hold their leaders accountable. The idea of not questioning the incumbent was evident from the RSP’s election campaign–‘Chup Chap Ghanti Chaap’ (quietly stamp the bell)—or the prime minister’s social media post that said dukkha hunus (rest assured). It is a telling sign when leaders encourage the public not to think critically or speak freely in a democracy, but to mechanically believe that the government is doing good work for the people. Advocating such a practice will be the death of a thoughtful Nepal. Dissent and questioning leaders are fundamental tenets in a democracy.

The single greatest blessing that emerged from the Gen Z movement is not that RSP now commands a majority in the House of Representatives. Instead, it is that the movement inspired the country’s youth to embrace their civic duty and actively participate in the democratic process.

The democratic process does not cease after voting. It is a continuous practice of seeking transparency, holding leaders accountable and asking questions from the very first day after a new government assumes power. When someone questions or criticises the Shah administration, it doesn’t necessarily mean they are loyal to the three legacy parties or are against the country’s development.

The pseudonym Chanakya was used by none other than Jawaharlal Nehru, who had been the president of the Indian National Congress for two consecutive terms. Nehru’s self-deprecating article warns the citizens and writes, “What if the fancy turns? Men like Jawaharlal, with all their capacity for great and good work, are unsafe in democracy. He calls himself a democrat and a socialist, and no doubt he does so in all earnestness, but every psychologist knows that the mind is ultimately a slave to the heart and logic can always be made to fit in with the desires and irrepressible urges of a person. A little twist and Jawaharlal might turn a dictator, sweeping aside the paraphernalia of a slow-moving democracy.”

The fallacy of hero-worship is the belief that a single leader will provide Nepal with its elixir for development. Leaders require loyalty from their supporters. However, both leaders and supporters need to draw a line between loyalty and sycophancy. The onus is on the citizens and party loyalists not to surrender themselves to a messiah. Nehru ends the article with, “We want no Caesars.” It is a warning to a democracy not to fall under the spell of a popular leader. Democracy in Nepal will be measured by the creation of stronger institutions, not by relying on a Nepali Caesar to save the country.
translated:
1937 मे द मॉडर्न रिव्यू (इंडिया) मे चाणक्य छद्म नाम सँ लिखल गेल द राष्ट्रपति नामक लेख प्रकाशित भेल । ई यूरोपीय राज्यऽ म॑ उभरतऽ ताकतवरऽ के पृष्ठभूमि म॑ लिखलऽ गेलऽ छेलै-जर्मनी म॑ हिटलर, रूस म॑ स्टालिन आरू इटली म॑ मुसोलिनी । चाणक्य जवाहरलाल नेहरू के आलोचना करै छै, जेकरऽ लोकप्रियता भारतीय जनता आरू भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के कार्यकर्ता सिनी के बीच बढ़ी रहलऽ छेलै । लेख राजनेता केरऽ नायक-पूजा के खिलाफ आरू ई बात के पूर्व चेतावनी छेलै कि नागरिकऽ स॑ ऐसनऽ व्यवहार, जे उद्धारकर्ता के तलाश करी रहलऽ छै, लोकतंत्र क॑ कोना खतरा म॑ डाल॑ सकै छै । चाणक्य एहि खतरा केँ चिन्हैत छथि आ लिखैत छथि, “जवाहरलाल आ भारतक लेल सेहो खतरा अछि।”

नेपाल सन नव लोकतंत्र सेहो एहन खतरा के सामने झुकि सकैत अछि जखन व्यक्तित्व पंथ के प्रशंसा के संग स्वागत कएल जाएत अछि जखन कि देवता बनल राजनीतिक नेता के खिलाफ असहमति के घोर उपहास आ साइबर धमकावे के सामना करय पड़ैत अछि. लोकतंत्र म॑ जब॑ नागरिक केवल एक व्यक्ति स॑ मोक्ष चाहै छै त॑ ई सार्वजनिक प्राधिकारी के बीच सत्ता के वितरण क॑ कमजोर करी सकै छै ।

सितंबर केरऽ जेन जेड विद्रोह के बाद मार्च केरऽ स्नैप पोल म॑ राष्ट्रीय स्वतंत्र पार्टी (आरएसपी) क॑ लगभग दू तिहाई बहुमत मिललै, जेकरा म॑ बलेन्द्र ‘बलेन’ शाह केरऽ नियुक्ति होय गेलै । विरोध प्रदर्शन म॑ पुरानऽ राजनीतिक दलऽ के अस्वीकृति के आवाज उठैलऽ गेलै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरऽ बार-बार डिलीवरी म॑ विफलता, खराब शासन, सिकोफैन्सी, आर्थिक ठहराव, आरू भ्रष्टाचार छै । चुनावी नारा, अब की बार बालेन सरकार आओर आरएसपी के अभियान किछ हद तक बालेन के लोकप्रियता आओर प्रधानमंत्री के कुर्सी पर बैसाबय पर टिकल छल.

भारी जनादेश मिलला के बावजूद संसदीय प्रक्रिया, अध्यादेश जारी करै, संवैधानिक निकाय स॑ निपटै आरू कूटनीतिक स्तर प॑ वर्तमान केरऽ मोडस ऑपरेंडी प॑ सवाल उठैलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

हाल ही म॑ प्रधानमंत्री केरऽ सलाहकार न॑ प्राधिकरण केरऽ दुरुपयोग केरऽ जांच आयोग (सीआईएए) केरऽ मुखिया आरू अधिकारियऽ क॑ बुलवाय क॑ जांच म॑ देरी के चलतें हुनका डांटलकै, जेकरा म॑ संवैधानिक निकायऽ के स्वतंत्रता क॑ कमजोर करतें हुअ॑ ओवररीच के प्रदर्शन करलऽ गेलै । संचालन शैली आओर भड़काऊ बयान स परेशान अछि। जेना कि आरएसपी केरऽ आम अधिवेशन म॑ अपनऽ भाषण के दौरान हुनी ई बात के जिक्र करलकै कि “जरूरत पड़ला प॑ हम्मं॑ सीआईएए स॑ खाली पाँच घंटा नै बल्कि पांच साल लेली परामर्श करबै ।” मध्य सत्र मे संसद स बाहर निकलि कोनो संवैधानिक निकाय क मुखिया कए डांटबाक तदर्थ व्यवहार युवा लोकतंत्र लेल नीक संकेत नहि अछि।

लोकतंत्र मे नेताक महत्व होइत छैक, मुदा स्थायी संस्था बेसी मायने रखैत अछि । बेंजामिन जोन्स आरू बेंजामिन ओल्केन, अपनऽ पेपर म॑, ‘की लीडर्स मैटर? द्वितीय विश्वयुद्ध के बाद स॑ राष्ट्रीय नेतृत्व आरू विकास’, ई जांच करै छै कि देश केरऽ विकास प॑ नेता सिनी के प्रभाव पड़ै छै कि नै । लेख केरऽ निष्कर्ष छै कि लोकतंत्र म॑ संस्था केरऽ भूमिका व्यक्तिगत नेता स॑ भी बड़ऽ होय छै । एहन नहि जे नेपाल सन देश मे मजबूत नेतृत्वक आवश्यकता नहि अछि । लेकिन अच्छा नेता स॑ भी जादा हुनका सब क॑ मजबूत संस्था आरू सरकार केरऽ शाखा के जरूरत छै जे कोनो भी तरह के कार्यकारी ओवररीच के खिलाफ नियंत्रण आरू संतुलन बनाबै सक॑ ।

लेकिन लोकतंत्र के लेलऽ आरू गंभीर खतरा नागरिकऽ के अपनऽ नेता प॑ सवाल उठाबै म॑ असमर्थता स॑ पैदा होय छै, व्यक्तित्व पंथ के सामने झुकना । जखन नागरिक नेता कए मसीहा मे बदलि दैत छथि त समर्थक अपन नेता कए जवाबदेह बनेबा लेल संघर्ष करैत छथि । वर्तमान पद पर सवाल नै उठै के विचार आरएसपी के चुनाव प्रचार–‘चुप चप घंटी चाप’ (चुपचाप घंटी पर मुहर लगाबै)—या प्रधानमंत्री के सोशल मीडिया पोस्ट स॑ स्पष्ट छेलै जेकरा म॑ दुखा हुनुस (निश्चित रहऽ) कहलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । ई एकटा बताबै वाला संकेत छै जब॑ नेता सिनी जनता क॑ प्रोत्साहित करै छै कि वू लोकतंत्र म॑ आलोचनात्मक रूप स॑ नै सोचै या स्वतंत्र रूप स॑ बोलै, बल्कि यंत्रवत रूप स॑ ई मान॑ कि सरकार जनता लेली अच्छा काम करी रहलऽ छै । एहन प्रथाक वकालत करब एकटा विचारशील नेपालक मृत्यु होयत। लोकतंत्र मे असहमति आ नेता पर सवाल ठाढ़ करब मौलिक सिद्धांत अछि ।

जेन जेड आंदोलन स॑ जे एकमात्र सबसें बड़ऽ आशीर्वाद सामने ऐलै, वू ई नै छै कि अब॑ आरएसपी केरऽ बहुमत के कमान प्रतिनिधि सभा म॑ छै । बल्कि ई छै कि ई आन्दोलन देश केरऽ युवा सिनी क॑ अपनऽ नागरिक कर्तव्य क॑ अपनाबै आरू लोकतांत्रिक प्रक्रिया म॑ सक्रिय रूप स॑ भाग लेबै लेली प्रेरित करलकै ।

मतदान के बाद लोकतांत्रिक प्रक्रिया बंद नहिं होइत अछि. पारदर्शिता के तलाश, नेता सब के जवाबदेह बनाबय के आ नव सरकार के सत्ता ग्रहण के पहिल दिन सं सवाल पूछय के ई निरंतर प्रथा अछि. जखन कियो शाह प्रशासन पर सवाल उठबैत अछि या आलोचना करैत अछि त’ एकर मतलब ई जरूरी नहि जे ओ तीनू विरासत दल के प्रति वफादार अछि या देश के विकास के खिलाफ अछि.

चाणक्य छद्म नामक प्रयोग जवाहरलाल नेहरू के अलावा दोसर कियो नहि केलक जे लगातार दू बेर भारतीय राष्ट्रीय कांग्रेस के अध्यक्ष रहल छल । नेहरू केरऽ आत्म-निंदा करै वाला लेख नागरिकऽ क॑ चेतावनी दै छै आरू लिखै छै कि अगर फैंसी घूमी जाय त॑ की होतै ।जवाहरलाल जैसनऽ आदमी, जेकरा म॑ अपनऽ महान आरू अच्छा काम करै के पूरा क्षमता छै, लोकतंत्र म॑ असुरक्षित छै । ओ अपना केँ लोकतांत्रिक आ समाजवादी कहैत छथि, आ निस्संदेह ओ पूरा गंभीरता सँ करैत छथि, मुदा हर मनोवैज्ञानिक केँ ई बुझल छनि जे अंततः मन हृदयक गुलाम होइत छैक आ तर्क केँ सदिखन कोनो व्यक्तिक इच्छा आ अदम्य आग्रहक अनुकूल बनाओल जा सकैत अछि। कनि मोड़ आ जवाहरलाल कोनो तानाशाह केँ घुमा सकैत छथि, धीमा गति सँ चलय बला लोकतंत्रक सामान केँ एक कात झाड़ि क’।”

वीर-पूजाक भ्रम ई विश्वास अछि जे एकटा नेता नेपाल केँ विकासक लेल ओकर अमृत उपलब्ध कराओत । नेता के अपन समर्थक स निष्ठा चाही। मुदा, नेता आ समर्थक दुनू के निष्ठा आ सिकोफैन्सी के बीच रेखा खींचय के जरूरत अछि. भार नागरिक आ पार्टी के वफादार पर अछि जे कोनो मसीहा के सामने अपना के नहि सौंपथि। नेहरू लेख समाप्त करैत छथि, “हमरा सभकेँ कोनो सीजर नहि चाही।” लोकतंत्र के लेल ई चेतावनी अछि जे कोनो लोकप्रिय नेता के जादू मे नहि पड़य. नेपाल मे लोकतंत्र के माप देश के बचाबय लेल नेपाली सीजर के भरोसे नहि, मजबूत संस्था के निर्माण स होयत।

Fukiage

Fukiage sits in Chikusa Ward. It is a residential pocket—mostly apartment blocks and small local shops—that trades the buzz of downtown for quieter streets, while still keeping the city centre close enough for a daily commute.

Pros

The subway ride into Sakae takes about 10 minutes, and cycling takes around 15 minutes. Rents here are noticeably cheaper than in areas closer to Sakae, making it one of the better-value options for students who still want quick access to the city.

Cons

There is not much beyond convenience stores and a few local diners. Students wanting nightlife or a café scene will need to travel into Sakae or Imaike, adding transport costs on top of the savings on rent.

Imaike

Imaike sits at the junction of the Higashiyama and Sakura-dori subway lines. The streets around the station are packed with ramen shops and small local eateries. It functions as a mini downtown of its own, long favored by young Japanese residents.

title: India court orders elephant safeguards - The Rising Nepal
description: India court orders elephant safeguards  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
New Delhi, Aug. 22: India's top court has ordered tough new steps to protect wild elephant herds as habitat loss and human-elephant conflict intensify, a move welcomed by campaigners on Friday.

The world's most populous nation is also home to the majority of Asian elephants, a species listed as endangered by the International Union for Conservation of Nature and whose habitat is increasingly being sliced up by highways and railways or clawed up by mines.

The Supreme Court has directed states to prevent the blockage of elephant corridors -- routes used by herds to move between rapidly shrinking habitats -- and ordered a survey to identify obstructions along those routes. That must include steps to end the use of any "coercive measure to divert the natural movement of the elephants", it read.

A ban on "hulla parties" -- groups deployed to drive elephants away using "fireballs" and burning stakes -- is required, it said. The court ruling, issued on Monday, said ministry guidelines were already in place to ensure "unobstructed" elephant corridors, but those routes have often been impeded.

Wildlife conservationist Prerna Singh Bindra, who led the pro bono public interest case, told AFP her petition had challenged state governments "supporting horrifically cruel practices". "It becomes a mob situation with thousands of people chasing the elephants using burning spears," she said. "That does nothing to resolve conflict; science shows it only exacerbates the conflict."

There are fewer than 50,000 Asian elephants in the wild, according to the World Wildlife Fund -- most in India, with others in Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia. Elephants are protected by law, are named as India's "national heritage animal", and many followers of the elephant-headed Hindu deity Ganesh see the animals as sacred. But they face mounting pressure from habitat loss, fragmentation, and increasing human-elephant conflict.

Bindra, a former member of India's top governing body for wildlife conservation and policy, the National Board for Wildlife, said the court's order was needed to ensure the survival of elephants in one of the most densely populated areas in the world. "We know where elephant corridors and habitats are -- and they are being destroyed and fragmented at an unprecedented pace," Bindra said. "The will to protect and preserve is markedly absent. We hope with this Supreme Court order, this survey must lead to action."

India's government elephant survey, released in October 2025, estimated 22,446 wild elephants nationwide -- but also warned the herds were found in a "mere fraction" of their historical range, occupying only 3.5 per cent of the area they once roamed. In a separate order, the top court on Tuesday ordered tighter welfare safeguards for India's more than 2,600 captive elephants, including ensuring medical records for each animal and regular health checks.

Captive elephants, once used commonly for logging, are now used for tourism, entertainment, and religious ceremonies. Animal rights campaign group PETA India said it welcomed measures to ease their suffering but maintained that "no elephant belongs in captivity".

भारत केरऽ वन्यजीव संरक्षण आरू नीति केरऽ शीर्ष शासी निकाय नेशनल बोर्ड फॉर वाइल्डलाइफ केरऽ पूर्व सदस्य बिंद्र न॑ कहलकै कि दुनिया केरऽ सबसें घन आबादी वाला इलाका म॑ हाथी के अस्तित्व सुनिश्चित करै लेली कोर्ट केरऽ ई आदेश के जरूरत छै । बिंद्र कहलकै, "हमरा सब क॑ पता छै कि हाथी के गलियारा आरू आवास कहाँ छै -- आरू ओकरा अभूतपूर्व गति स॑ नष्ट करी क॑ खंडित करी देलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै । "सुरक्षा आ संरक्षण के इच्छाशक्ति स्पष्ट रूप स अनुपस्थित अछि। हमरा सब कए उम्मीद अछि जे सुप्रीम कोर्ट क एहि आदेश स एहि सर्वेक्षण स कार्रवाई हेबाक चाही।"

title: Nepal has cheap money. So why isn’t credit growing? - OnlineKhabar English News
description: Nepal has cheap money. So why isn’t credit growing?  OnlineKhabar English News
publisher.title: OnlineKhabar English News
full_article:
Nepal is experiencing historically low interest rates, with lending and deposit rates exceptionally low by the country’s own standards. As of mid-May 2026, the numbers make this clear.

The commercial banks’ weighted average deposit rate stood at 3.35%, while the weighted average lending rate was 6.73%. The commercial banks’ base rate stood at 4.97%.

So, if all the rates are cheap, why isn’t credit growing?

First, it is important to be clear that cheap credit does not necessarily create credit demand. The traditional assumption is that lower interest rates bring cheaper loans, which lead to higher borrowing, higher investment and higher economic growth. Despite lending rates falling to around 6.7%, however, credit growth has remained subdued. Nepal Rastra Bank reports private-sector credit growth of around 6%, far below the 12% target.

This shows why the relationship between interest rates and credit growth is not straightforward. Interest rates are only one component of credit demand. People tend to borrow when they see investment opportunities, demand for their products, confidence in the economy, a predictable economic future, predictable regulations, expected profitability and political stability.

This raises the real question: “Cheap money may not always support profitable investment opportunities.”

The bigger question, then, is what happens to that cheap money when people do not see profitable opportunities to put it into?

One possible outcome is asset-price inflation. If credit becomes cheaper while productive investment remains weak, money can flow into assets rather than production, with potential destinations including real estate, gold, shares, private vehicles or even speculative assets. With fixed deposit rates falling near or below the inflation rate of around 5%, depositors face negative or near-zero real returns. Capital may therefore shift out of formal bank deposits.

Another possibility is that banks may become more aggressive. With cheaper pricing, banks may tend to increase their profitability through volume-based lending. That can result in aggressive lending and more competition for quality borrowers.

Banks may also focus on fee-based income. Existing borrowers may use cheaper loans to refinance expensive debt, which does not necessarily create new economic activity, although it may help manage the borrower’s cash flow. If banks chase loan growth simply to compensate for lower margins, credit quality can deteriorate.

This can be best explained with a simple hypothetical example. Say Swagat Acharya is a businessman who runs a slipper factory where he expects the rate of return to be around 6% from his business operation, and he can borrow at 7% per annum. Considering the economic scenario, including labour costs, competition, regulatory risk, inflation and political instability, Acharya may feel reluctant to borrow the loan even though borrowing rates are historically low.

Now, say rates fall further to 5.5%. What should Acharya do? The investment still may not happen if he believes the project will generate only 6% while carrying substantial risk. Instead of investing in the business, he may look toward investment in speculative assets where he could get a higher return.

It is also important to look at the banks’ side. Credit may not be growing faster only because people do not want to borrow. Banks have also become more cautious after years of rising bad loans and higher provisioning requirements. Even when banks have plenty of money to lend and interest rates are low, they may still hesitate to lend to riskier borrowers. So, the slowdown is likely a combination of two things: borrowers are not seeing enough profitable opportunities, and banks are becoming more careful about where they lend.

So, what should be done?

The focus has to shift from “cheap money” to “productive use of money.”

This is where both the government and the banking sector have a role to play.

The government needs to create profitable investment opportunities in sectors where Nepal has comparative advantages, such as hydropower, tourism, agriculture, IT and infrastructure. It also needs to improve investor confidence. Stable policies, taxation, regulations and licensing can be more powerful for investment than another 1% reduction in lending rates.

Reducing the cost of doing business is equally important, particularly by addressing unclear policies and unpredictable regulations. Government spending needs to be used more strategically, while exports should be promoted. Depositors should also be given better investment alternatives.

The banking and financial sector, meanwhile, needs to focus lending on productive sectors. Lending should be based on cash flow and a viable business plan, rather than simply against land or property ownership. Banks should use cheaper credit to help businesses expand, improve technology, increase productivity and enter new markets, rather than simply replacing old expensive loans.

At the same time, banks should not reduce lending standards simply to increase loan volumes. Cheap money should not become cheap lending. Banks need to balance loan growth, NPL risk and profitability.

The paradox, in the end, comes down to this: Nepal’s problem right now is not a lack of money. The problem is that there are not enough good and profitable places to invest it.

Lower interest rates alone cannot create demand, confidence or good investment opportunities. If this continues, people may put more money into land, gold, financial and speculative assets instead of productive businesses, while savers continue to earn less from their deposits.

Bringing interest rates down may have been the easy part. The real challenge is creating better investment opportunities, stable policies and ensuring that banks lend money to productive sectors.

एहि सं पता चलैत अछि जे ब्याज दर आओर क्रेडिट ग्रोथ के बीच संबंध सीधा किएक नहिं अछि. ब्याज दर ऋण मांग कें एकटा घटक मात्र छै. लोगऽ क॑ निवेश के अवसर, अपनऽ उत्पाद केरऽ मांग, अर्थव्यवस्था प॑ भरोसा, पूर्वानुमानित आर्थिक भविष्य, पूर्वानुमानित नियम, अपेक्षित लाभप्रदता आरू राजनीतिक स्थिरता देखला प॑ उधार लेबै के प्रवृत्ति छै ।

एहि स असली सवाल उठैत अछि जे “सस्ता पैसा हमेशा लाभदायक निवेश क अवसर कए समर्थन नहि करि सकैत अछि।”

तखन एहि सं पैघ सवाल ई अछि जे जखन लोक के ओहि सस्ता पाई के ओहि मे डालय के फायदा के मौका नहिं देखाइत अछि त ओकर की भ जाएत अछि.

एकर एकटा संभावित परिणाम अछि संपत्ति-मूल्य महंगाई। यदि ऋण सस्ता भ जायत छै जखन कि उत्पादक निवेश कमजोर रहत त उत्पादन कें बजाय संपत्ति मे पैसा कें प्रवाह भ सकय छै, जइ मे संभावित गंतव्यक मे रियल एस्टेट, सोना, शेयर, निजी वाहन या सट्टा संपत्तिय शामिल छै. फिक्स्ड डिपॉजिट दर लगभग 5% के महंगाई दर के पास या ओकरा सं नीचा गिरला सं जमाकर्ता के नकारात्मक या शून्य के करीब वास्तविक रिटर्न के सामना करय पड़ैत अछि. अइ कें लेल पूंजी औपचारिक बैंक जमा सं बाहर शिफ्ट भ सकय छै.

एकटा आओर संभावना अछि जे बैंक आओर आक्रामक भ सकैत अछि. सस्ता मूल्य निर्धारण सं बैंकक कें वॉल्यूम आधारित ऋण कें माध्यम सं अपन मुनाफा बढ़ाबय कें प्रवृत्ति भ सकय छै. जेकरऽ परिणामस्वरूप आक्रामक ऋण आरू गुणवत्तापूर्ण उधारकर्ता लेली अधिक प्रतिस्पर्धा पैदा होय सकै छै ।

बैंक शुल्क आधारित आय पर सेहो ध्यान द सकैत अछि। मौजूदा उधारकर्ता महग ऋण कें पुनर्वित्तपोषण कें लेल सस्ता ऋण कें उपयोग कयर सकय छै, जे जरूरी नहि छै की नव आर्थिक गतिविधि पैदा करय, हालांकि इ उधारकर्ता कें नकदी प्रवाह कें प्रबंधन मे मदद कयर सकय छै. अगर बैंक सिर्फ कम मार्जिन के भरपाई के लेल लोन ग्रोथ के पीछा करत त क्रेडिट के क्वालिटी खराब भ सकैत अछि.

एकरा एकटा सरल काल्पनिक उदाहरण सॅं बेसी नीक जकाँ बुझाओल जा सकैत अछि । कहियो स्वगत आचार्य एकटा व्यवसायी छथि जे चप्पल फैक्ट्री चलाबैत छथि जतय हुनका उम्मीद छनि जे हुनकर बिजनेस ऑपरेशन स रिटर्न के दर लगभग 6% होयत, आ ओ सालाना 7% पर उधार ल सकैत छथि। श्रम लागत, प्रतिस्पर्धा, नियामक जोखिम, महंगाई आ राजनीतिक अस्थिरता सहित आर्थिक परिदृश्य कए देखैत आचार्य ऋण लेबा मे संकोच महसूस क सकैत छथि, भले ही उधार क दर ऐतिहासिक रूप स कम अछि।

आब कहब जे दर आओर गिरि कए 5.5% भ गेल। आचार्य के की करबाक चाही? निवेश एखनो नहि भ सकैत अछि अगर हुनकर मानब अछि जे एहि परियोजना स मात्र 6% क आमदनी होएत जखन कि काफी जोखिम सेहो होएत। व्यवसाय मे निवेश करय के बजाय ओ सट्टा संपत्ति मे निवेश के तरफ देख सकय छथिन्ह जतय हुनका बेसि रिटर्न मिल सकय.

बैंक के तरफ सेहो देखब जरूरी अछि. भ सकैत अछि जे केवल एहि लेल क्रेडिट तेजी स नहि बढ़ि रहल अछि जे लोक कर्ज नहि लेबय चाहैत अछि। सालों सं बढ़ैत बैड लोन आओर बेसि प्रोविजनिंग के जरूरत के बाद बैंक सेहो बेसि सावधान भ गेल अछि. जखन बैंकक कें पास उधार देवय कें लेल बहुत पैसा छै आ ब्याज दर कम छै, तखनो ओ बेसि जोखिम वाला उधारकर्ताक कें उधार देवय सं संकोच कयर सकय छै. अस्तु, संभवतः ई मंदी दू चीजक संयोजन थिक : कर्ज लेनिहार कें पर्याप्त लाभदायक अवसर नहिं देखा रहल छनि, आ बैंक एहि बात सं बेसी सावधान भ रहल छथि जे ओ कतय उधार दैत छथि.

तखन, की करबाक चाही?

ध्यान “सस्ता पैसा” स “पैसा के उत्पादक उपयोग” पर बदलय पड़त।

एहि ठाम सरकार आ बैंकिंग क्षेत्र दुनू क भूमिका अछि।

सरकार के ओहि क्षेत्र मे लाभदायक निवेश के अवसर पैदा करय के जरूरत अछि जतय नेपाल के तुलनात्मक फायदा अछि, जेना जलविद्युत, पर्यटन, कृषि, आईटी आओर बुनियादी ढांचा. एकरा निवेशक क विश्वास मे सेहो सुधार करबाक जरूरत अछि। स्थिर नीति, कर, नियम आ लाइसेंसिंग निवेश कें लेल ऋण दर मे एकटा आओर 1% कमी सं बेसि शक्तिशाली भ सकय छै.

व्यवसाय करय कें लागत कें कम करनाय ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण छै, खासकर अस्पष्ट नीतियक आ अप्रत्याशित नियमक कें संबोधित करयत. सरकारी खर्च कए बेसी रणनीतिक रूप स उपयोग करबाक जरूरत अछि, जखन कि निर्यात कए बढ़ावा देबाक चाही। जमाकर्ता कें निवेश कें बेहतर विकल्प सेहो देल जेबाक चाही.

ओतहि बैंकिंग आ वित्तीय क्षेत्र कए उत्पादक क्षेत्र पर ऋण देबा पर ध्यान देबाक जरूरत अछि। ऋण केवल जमीन या संपत्ति कें मालिकाना हक कें खिलाफ नहि, बल्कि नकदी प्रवाह आ व्यवहार्य व्यवसाय योजना कें आधार पर होबाक चाही. बैंकक कें सस्ता क्रेडिट कें उपयोग व्यवसायक कें विस्तार, तकनीक मे सुधार, उत्पादकता बढ़ावा आ नव बाजार मे प्रवेश मे मदद करय कें लेल करबाक चाही, नहि कि केवल पुरान महग ऋण कें बदलय कें.

एकर संगहि बैंक कए केवल ऋण क मात्रा बढ़ेबा लेल ऋण क मानक मे कमी नहि करबाक चाही। सस्ता पाइ सस्ता उधार नहि बनबाक चाही। बैंक कए लोन क वृद्धि, एनपीएल क जोखिम आ मुनाफा क संतुलन बनेबाक जरूरत अछि।

विरोधाभास, अंत मे, एहि पर उतरैत अछि जे नेपाल’क समस्या एखन पाइ के कमी नहिं अछि. समस्या ई अछि जे एहि मे निवेश करय लेल एतेक नीक आओर फायदेमंद जगह नहिं अछि.

असगर ब्याज दर कम भेला स मांग, आत्मविश्वास या निवेश क नीक अवसर नहि भ सकैत अछि। अगर ई जारी रहत त लोक उत्पादक व्यवसाय के बजाय जमीन... सोना... वित्तीय आओर सट्टा संपत्ति मे बेसि पाई लगा सकय छथिन्ह, जखन कि बचत करय वाला के अपन जमा सं कम कमाई जारी रहत.

ब्याज दर कम करब आसान हिस्सा भ सकैत अछि। असली चुनौती बेहतर निवेश के अवसर, स्थिर नीति आरू ई सुनिश्चित करना छै कि बैंक उत्पादक क्षेत्रऽ क॑ पैसा उधार दै ।

In Brief:

190,000 doses of ARV vaccine procured via international tender in April 2026

Vaccine manufactured by Liaoning Cheng Da Biotechnology Co Ltd, China under brand name Speeda

Department says vaccine meets WHO-GMP standards and has lot-release certification

Public urged not to be misled by inaccurate reports that could disrupt health services

The Department of Health Services has rejected reports questioning the quality and procurement of the anti-rabies vaccine (ARV) being used in Nepal, saying the vaccine was purchased through a prescribed international bidding process and meets the required quality standards.

Issuing a clarification, the department said it had procured 190,000 doses of 0.5 ml ARV vaccine for the Epidemiology and Disease Control Division after inviting an international tender on April 12, 2026, in accordance with the Public Procurement Act.

According to the department, the vaccine, manufactured by Liaoning Cheng Da Biotechnology Co Ltd of China under the brand name Speeda, was imported following the required regulatory and procurement procedures.

The department said the vaccine is manufactured in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) standards. It also said the vaccine has been used in several countries and that the relevant regulatory authority has granted the required lot-release certification.

The clarification noted that the department had purchased the vaccine through a competitive international bidding process based on the WHO-PQ or WHO-GMP-related criteria specified in the tender documents.

The department also rejected claims that the vaccine must contain a particular substance under Nepal's Drug Act, saying such a requirement does not apply in the manner suggested by the report. It said medicines and vaccines registered and used in Nepal are supplied after meeting applicable quality and regulatory requirements.

The department urged the public not to be misled by what it described as inaccurate information and said misleading reports could disrupt health services and create unnecessary public concern.

It has also asked health institutions, health workers and service users to use the ARV vaccine in accordance with the National Guidelines for Rabies Prophylaxis and Management in Nepal.

title: Nepal showcases tourism at PATA Travel Mart 2026 in Sarawak - The Tourism Times
description: Nepal showcases tourism at PATA Travel Mart 2026 in Sarawak  The Tourism Times
publisher.title: The Tourism Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Nepal showcased its tourism attractions and connected with international travel trade partners at the PATA Travel Mart (PTM) 2026, held from August 18 to 20 in Kuching, Sarawak, Malaysia.

The PATA Nepal Chapter, in collaboration with Nepal Airlines and nine private-sector travel companies, represented Nepal at the three-day international business-to-business travel trade event through a dedicated Nepal Pavilion. The participation provided Nepali tourism companies with an opportunity to meet global buyers, explore new markets and develop business partnerships.

PTM 2026 brought together more than 1,100 tourism delegates from 48 countries and destinations at the Borneo Convention Centre Kuching. The event featured business appointments between buyers and sellers from across the Asia-Pacific and beyond.

The Nepali exhibitors promoted a range of tourism products, including mountaineering, trekking, spiritual tourism, luxury travel and community-based tourism. During two days of B2B sessions, representatives of Nepali companies held meetings with international buyers and travel trade partners, according to the PATA Nepal Chapter.

The chapter said the participation generated meaningful connections and potential collaborations, while providing a platform to strengthen Nepal's visibility in international tourism markets.

The event also offered delegates an opportunity to experience Sarawak's cultural and culinary heritage. The “Soul of Borneo” Gala Dinner, hosted by Sarawak's Ministry of Tourism, Creative Industry and Performing Arts, featured indigenous music and dance as well as local cuisine. The Nepal delegation also took part in networking and other activities alongside the trade sessions.

PTM 2026 was held at the Borneo Convention Centre Kuching from August 18 to 20 and marked the first time PATA's flagship travel trade event was hosted in Sarawak. The programme included a Knowledge Forum, business sessions and networking opportunities aimed at developing new partnerships and expanding tourism markets.

The Nepal participation came shortly after the PATA Nepal Chapter received the PATA Award of Excellence 2026 at the PATA Chapter and Student Chapter Awards ceremony in Kuching on August 17, a day before PTM opened. The award recognised the chapter's contribution to the development and promotion of tourism in the Asia-Pacific region.

The chapter said its participation at PTM 2026 further reinforced its efforts to promote Nepal as a diverse destination and strengthen cooperation between Nepali tourism businesses and international travel partners.

पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर नेपाल एयरलाइंस आ नौ निजी क्षेत्रक यात्रा कम्पनीक सहयोगमे तीन दिवसीय अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय व्यवसाय-व्यापार यात्रा व्यापारिक आयोजनमे एक समर्पित नेपाल मंडपके माध्यमसँ नेपालक प्रतिनिधित्व केलक । एहि सहभागिता स नेपाली पर्यटन कंपनी कए वैश्विक खरीदार स भेंट करबाक, नव बाजार क खोज करबाक आ व्यापारिक साझेदारी विकसित करबाक अवसर भेटल।

पीटीएम २०२६ म॑ बोर्नियो कन्वेंशन सेंटर कुचिंग म॑ ४८ देश आरू गंतव्यऽ स॑ १,१०० स॑ भी अधिक पर्यटन प्रतिनिधि सिनी क॑ एक साथ लानलऽ गेलै । ई आयोजन म॑ पूरा एशिया-प्रशांत आरू ओकरा स॑ बाहर के खरीदार आरू विक्रेता के बीच व्यापारिक नियुक्ति के आयोजन करलऽ गेलै ।

नेपाली प्रदर्शकसब पर्वतारोहण, ट्रेकिंग, आध्यात्मिक पर्यटन, विलासिता यात्रा आ समुदाय आधारित पर्यटन सहित अनेक पर्यटन उत्पाद के प्रचार केलक । बी टू बी सत्र के दू दिन के दौरान नेपाली कंपनी के प्रतिनिधि अंतरराष्ट्रीय खरीदार आ ट्रैवल ट्रेड पार्टनर के संग बैसार केलनि, पाटा नेपाल चैप्टर के अनुसार।

अध्याय न॑ कहलकै कि ई सहभागिता स॑ सार्थक कनेक्शन आरू संभावित सहयोग पैदा होय गेलै, जबकि अंतरराष्ट्रीय पर्यटन बाजार म॑ नेपाल केरऽ दृश्यता क॑ मजबूत करै के मंच उपलब्ध कराय देलऽ गेलै ।

ई आयोजन म॑ प्रतिनिधि सिनी क॑ सारावाक केरऽ सांस्कृतिक आरू पाक विरासत के अनुभव करै के मौका भी मिललै । सारावाक केरऽ पर्यटन, रचनात्मक उद्योग आरू प्रदर्शन कला मंत्रालय द्वारा आयोजित “सोल ऑफ बोर्नियो” गाला डिनर म॑ देशी संगीत आरू नृत्य के साथ-साथ स्थानीय भोजन भी शामिल छेलै । नेपाल प्रतिनिधिमंडल व्यापार सत्रक संग-संग नेटवर्किंग आ अन्य गतिविधि मे सेहो भाग लेलक।

पीटीएम २०२६ १८ स॑ २० अगस्त तलक बोर्नियो कन्वेंशन सेंटर कुचिंग म॑ आयोजित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै आरू ई पहलऽ बार सारावाक म॑ पाटा केरऽ प्रमुख यात्रा व्यापार आयोजन के आयोजन करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । कार्यक्रम म॑ नॉलेज फोरम, बिजनेस सेशन आरू नेटवर्किंग के अवसर शामिल छेलै जेकरऽ उद्देश्य नया साझेदारी विकसित करना आरू पर्यटन बाजार के विस्तार करना छेलै ।

पीटीएम खुलबा स एक दिन पहिने 17 अगस्त कए कुचिंग मे पाटा चैप्टर आ छात्र अध्याय पुरस्कार समारोह मे पाटा नेपाल अध्याय कए पाटा उत्कृष्टता पुरस्कार 2026 भेटलाक किछुए देर बाद नेपालक सहभागिता आयल अछि। ई पुरस्कार एशिया-प्रशांत क्षेत्र मँ पर्यटन के विकास आरू संवर्धन मँ अध्याय केरौ योगदान क पहचानलौ गेलौ छै ।

अध्याय न॑ कहलकै कि पीटीएम २०२६ म॑ ओकरऽ भागीदारी स॑ नेपाल क॑ विविध गंतव्य के रूप म॑ बढ़ावा दै आरू नेपाली पर्यटन व्यवसाय आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय यात्रा भागीदार के बीच सहयोग क॑ मजबूत करै के प्रयास क॑ आरू मजबूत करलऽ गेलै ।

title: Nepal Association of Foreign Employment Agencies Opposes Malaysia's FW CMS Plan - Ratopati
description: Nepal Association of Foreign Employment Agencies Opposes Malaysia's FW CMS Plan  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The Nepal Association of Foreign Employment Agencies has objected to the plan to send Nepali workers by including only 25 Nepali foreign employment business organizations in Malaysia's Foreign Workers Centralized Management System (FWCMS).

The association has demanded that all entrepreneurs operating foreign employment businesses with legal licenses in Nepal should be given equal opportunities and the right to compete. The association claims that if only a limited number of organizations are included in FWCMS, a monopoly and syndicate situation may arise in the foreign employment sector.

Since Malaysia is a major destination for Nepali workers, the association stated that the process of sending workers there should be advanced in a transparent and competitive manner in accordance with the bilateral labor agreement between Nepal and Malaysia and the established diplomatic mechanism.

मलेसिया रोजगारीमा सिन्डिकेट : २५ वटा मात्रै म्यानपावरले मात्र श्रमिक पठाउन पाउने

Stating that about 1,100 foreign employment entrepreneurs and organizations are operating with licenses in Nepal, the association has made it clear that the system of giving opportunities only to a certain group or limited organizations is not acceptable.

Meanwhile, the association has also expressed concern about the public release of an Excel list containing the names of about 250 licensed organizations. Stating that the list has created confusion and uncertainty among entrepreneurs, the association has said that the concerned bodies should provide clear information about the actual decision and process.

Discussion with the Ministry of Labor

The association has stated that the Ministry of Youth, Labor, and Employment has also been drawn to the issue of including only limited organizations in FWCMS. The association said that the ministry has raised Nepal's concerns by discussing with the acting ambassador of Nepal to Malaysia.

The association stated that the ministry's view is that issues related to labor migration between Nepal and Malaysia should be advanced on the basis of bilateral discussions, consultations, and agreements.

The association has welcomed the government's initiative and urged that discussions should be advanced through the Nepal-Malaysia bilateral labor mechanism to resolve the problem.

Clarification to 25 Organizations

Meanwhile, the association has sought clarification from the 25 organizations that are said to be included in FWCMS. As per the decision of the emergency meeting of the association, those organizations have been asked to submit clarification with facts, evidence, and relevant documents within three days.

The association has stated that if clarification is not provided within the stipulated time or if the clarification received is not satisfactory, necessary action will be taken in accordance with the association's bylaws, code of conduct, and prevailing laws.

Initiative for Investigation in Government Bodies

The association states that an investigation is necessary to determine whether there is any syndicate, monopoly, or professional discrimination in the process of including only limited organizations in FWCMS.

The association has stated that it will collect necessary evidence and documents and inform the relevant bodies including the Department of Foreign Employment, Ministry of Youth, Labor and Employment, Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Financial Information Unit, Commission for Investigation of Abuse of Authority.

The association has clarified that it does not intend to hold any entrepreneur or organization guilty based on prejudice, and if illegal monopoly, syndicate, financial irregularities, or professional discrimination are proven, it will proceed legally and institutionally.

The association's president, Dik Bahadur Khatri (Kumar), stated that the monopoly of a limited group in the foreign employment sector is not acceptable and that the association stands for equal opportunities, healthy competition, and the welfare of workers.

नेपाल मे कानूनी लाइसेंस वाला विदेशी रोजगार व्यवसाय संचालित करय वाला सब उद्यमी के समान अवसर आ प्रतिस्पर्धा के अधिकार देबय के मांग संघ केने अछि. एसोसिएशन के दावा छै कि अगर एफडब्ल्यूसीएमएस म॑ सीमित संख्या म॑ ही संगठन क॑ शामिल करलऽ जाय त॑ विदेशी रोजगार क्षेत्र म॑ एकाधिकार आरू सिंडिकेशन के स्थिति पैदा होय सकै छै ।

मलेशिया नेपाली मजदूर केरऽ प्रमुख गंतव्य होय के कारण संघ न॑ कहलकै कि नेपाल आरू मलेशिया के बीच द्विपक्षीय श्रम समझौता आरू स्थापित कूटनीतिक तंत्र के अनुसार वहाँ मजदूर भेजै के प्रक्रिया क॑ पारदर्शी आरू प्रतिस्पर्धी तरीका स॑ आगू बढ़ाबै के चाही ।

मले ब्रीण व्रतक : २५ वटाही म्यानपावरे िे िििमा सिाउन पाउने

नेपालमे लगभग ११०० विदेशी रोजगार उद्यमी आ संस्था अनुज्ञापत्रक संग संचालित भऽ रहल कहैत संघ स्पष्ट कएने अछि जे मात्र कोनो निश्चित समूह वा सीमित संस्थाकेँ अवसर देबाक व्यवस्था स्वीकार्य नहि अछि ।

एम्हर, एसोसिएशन एक्सेल लिस्ट के सार्वजनिक रूप सं जारी करय पर सेहो चिंता जतौने अछि जाहि मे करीब 250 लाइसेंसधारी संगठन के नाम लिखल अछि. एहि सूची स उद्यमी मे भ्रम आ अनिश्चितता पैदा भेल कहैत संघ कहलक अछि जे संबंधित निकाय कए वास्तविक निर्णय आ प्रक्रिया क बारे मे स्पष्ट जानकारी देबाक चाही।

श्रम मंत्रालय के साथ चर्चा

एसोसिएशन न॑ कहल॑ छै कि युवा, श्रम, आरू रोजगार मंत्रालय क॑ भी एफडब्ल्यूसीएमएस म॑ सीमित संगठनऽ क॑ ही शामिल करै के मुद्दा प॑ आकर्षित करलऽ गेलऽ छै । मलेशियामे रहल नेपालके कार्यवाहक राजदूतसँग मन्त्रालय नेपालके चिन्ता व्यक्त कएलक संघ जनौलक अछि ।

संघ न॑ कहलकै कि मंत्रालय केरऽ विचार छै कि नेपाल आरू मलेशिया के बीच मजदूर पलायन स॑ जुड़लऽ मुद्दा क॑ द्विपक्षीय चर्चा, परामर्श, आरू समझौता के आधार प॑ आगू बढ़ाबै के चाही ।

संघ सरकारके पहलके स्वागत करैत नेपाल-मलेशिया द्विपक्षीय श्रम तंत्रके माध्यमसँ समस्याके समाधानके लेल विमर्श आगू बढेबाक आग्रह केने अछि ।

25 संगठनों को स्पष्टीकरण

एम्हर एसोसिएशन एफडब्ल्यूसीएमएस मे शामिल 25 संगठन स स्पष्टीकरण मंगलक अछि। संघ केरऽ आपातकालीन बैठक केरऽ फैसला के अनुसार वू संगठनऽ स॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छै कि वू तीन दिन के भीतर तथ्य, सबूत, आरू प्रासंगिक दस्तावेज के साथ स्पष्टीकरण पेश करै ।

संघ न॑ कहल॑ छै कि अगर निर्धारित समय के भीतर स्पष्टीकरण नै देलऽ जाय छै या प्राप्त स्पष्टीकरण संतोषजनक नै होय छै त॑ संघ केरऽ उपनियम, आचार संहिता, आरू प्रचलित कानून के अनुसार आवश्यक कार्रवाई करलऽ जैतै ।

सरकारी निकाय मे जांच हेतु पहल

संघ कें कहनाय छै कि एफडब्ल्यूसीएमएस मे केवल सीमित संगठनक कें शामिल करय कें प्रक्रिया मे कोनों सिंडिकेशन, एकाधिकार, या पेशेवर भेदभाव छै या नहि, इ निर्धारित करय कें लेल जांच आवश्यक छै.

एसोसिएशन न॑ कहलकै कि हुनी आवश्यक सबूत आरू दस्तावेज इकट्ठा करी क॑ विदेश रोजगार विभाग, युवा, श्रम आरू रोजगार मंत्रालय, विदेश मंत्रालय, वित्तीय सूचना इकाई, प्राधिकरण के दुरुपयोग के जांच आयोग सहित संबंधित निकाय क॑ सूचित करी देल॑ छै ।

एसोसिएशन न॑ स्पष्ट करलकै कि ओकरऽ इरादा पूर्वाग्रह के आधार प॑ कोनो भी उद्यमी या संगठन क॑ दोषी ठहराबै के नै छै, आरू अगर गैरकानूनी एकाधिकार, सिंडिकेशन, वित्तीय गड़बड़ी, या पेशेवर भेदभाव साबित होय जाय छै त॑ ई कानूनी आरू संस्थागत रूप स॑ आगू बढ़तै ।

संघ के अध्यक्ष डिक बहादुर खत्री (कुमार) न॑ कहलकै कि विदेशी रोजगार क्षेत्र म॑ सीमित समूह केरऽ एकाधिकार स्वीकार्य नै छै आरू ई संघ समान अवसर, स्वस्थ प्रतिस्पर्धा, आरू मजदूरऽ के कल्याण लेली खड़ा छै ।

publisher.title: OnlineKhabar English News
full_article:
Kathmandu, August 23

Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) lawmaker and mountaineer Mingma Gyabu Sherpa has called for concerted efforts to prevent skilled mountaineers and mountain guides from leaving Nepal for better opportunities abroad.

Speaking at a programme organised in Kathmandu on Sunday to mark the 25th anniversary of the Everest Summiteers Association, Sherpa said the country could face serious challenges in the mountaineering tourism sector if mountain guides are not provided with fair wages and mountaineers are not given proper recognition and respect.

Sherpa said Nepal’s tourism sector is still operating under the Tourism Act enacted in 1978 and that the country has now reached a stage where the law needs to be replaced.

“I am now at a point where we need to change the Tourism Act enacted in 1978. Stakeholders will discuss the Tourism Bill tomorrow,” he said.

He urged mountaineers and their organisations to clearly present their concerns and demands so that their rights and problems can be incorporated into the new legislation.

“If you do not clearly raise your demands for your rights, there will be no justification for remaining in those organisations,” he said.

Sherpa said a parliamentary committee would hold discussions with stakeholders on the Tourism Bill on Monday and urged mountaineers to submit suggestions on how their problems and rights should be addressed through the new law.

He said mountaineers should put forward their concerns without personal interests or political considerations.

“If you present your views independently of personal interests and politics, focusing on the rights of the mountaineering sector and the future of Nepal’s tourism, it will be easier to formulate the law accordingly,” he said.

Sherpa said he remained committed to addressing problems in the sector and expressed concern that Nepal was failing to retain mountaineers despite having abundant mountains and natural resources.

“We have enough mountains naturally, but we have not been able to retain mountaineers. Therefore, policy-level reforms are necessary in the mountaineering sector,” he said.

He warned that failure to work together to protect the rights of mountaineers and prevent skilled professionals from leaving Nepal could create even more serious challenges for the country’s mountaineering and tourism sectors.

title: 'People suffering from leprosy deserve more than sympathy' - The Rising Nepal

publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 23: Speakers at a programme have said the people suffering from leprosy should be empowered through social security schemes so that they can be self-sufficient and competent.

Former chief justice Kalyan Shrestha said the dignity of people living with leprosy was hurt because they were deprived of education, health, employment and even detachment from family and society. It is imperative to assure their rights with legal guarantee, he stressed.

"Nepali society has a negative perspective towards leprosy, so it needs changing," he said, urging the government to empower them along with social justice. Only sympathy does not suffice but empowerment.

During a programme conducted by various organizations including the Nepal Law Society, the Association for Idea Nepal and the Nepal Leprosy Prevention Association, Acting Mayor of Kathmandu Metropolis, Sunita Dangol, viewed leprosy is not a problem but a different health condition. "Such people must be provided rights and opportunities," she argued.

In his presentation focusing the social security and economic empowerment of people living with leprosy, former finance secretary of government, Sishir Dhungana, suggested introduction of self-entrepreneurship programmes to the people living with leprosy. Seed money and concessional loans are other equally important schemes, according to him.

Dhungana further said skill development training and employment can help improve their living standard. Once the marketing is managed for the products made by such people with entrepreneurship, it helps manage their income.

It was shared at the programme that nearly 200 thousand people were affected by leprosy in Nepal at present, among which, 30,000 have been disabled. The number of people contracting this disease every year ranges from 2,000 to 2,500.

Still in Madhes Province, more than one person in 10,000 gets contracted to the leprosy causing bacteria.

Undersecretary at Ministry of Women, Children, Gender and Sexual Minorities and Social Security, Nira Adhikari, said the disability is an issue of multidimensional social debate. Inclusion of differently able people is not a technical challenge but a political and moral, she asserted.(RSS)

पूर्व मुख्य न्यायाधीश कल्याण श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, कोढ़ सं पीड़ित लोकक गरिमा आहत अछि, कारण ओ शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य, रोजगार आ परिवार आ समाज सं सेहो विरक्ति सं वंचित छथि। कानूनी गारंटी के साथ हुनकऽ अधिकार के आश्वासन देना जरूरी छै, ई बात प॑ हुनी जोर देलकै ।

ओ कहलनि जे, नेपाली समाज के कोढ़ के प्रति नकारात्मक दृष्टिकोण अछि, ताहि लेल एकरा बदलबाक आवश्यकता अछि। केवल सहानुभूति पर्याप्त नहि बल्कि सशक्तिकरण।

कोढ़ स॑ पीड़ित लोगऽ के सामाजिक सुरक्षा आरू आर्थिक सशक्तिकरण प॑ केंद्रित अपनऽ प्रस्तुति म॑ सरकार केरऽ पूर्व वित्त सचिव सिशिर ढुंगाना न॑ कोढ़ स॑ पीड़ित लोगऽ क॑ स्व उद्यमिता कार्यक्रम शुरू करै के सुझाव देलकै । बीज पैसा आ रियायती ऋण अन्य ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण योजना अछि, हुनकर अनुसार।

धुंगना आगू कहलनि जे, कौशल विकास प्रशिक्षण आ रोजगार हुनकर जीवन स्तर मे सुधार करबा मे मदद क सकैत अछि। एक बेर उद्यमिता वाला एहन लोक द्वारा बनाओल गेल उत्पाद के मार्केटिंग के प्रबंधन भ गेल त हुनकर आमदनी के प्रबंधन में मदद मिलैत अछि.

कार्यक्रम मे साझा कएल गेल जे नेपाल मे वर्तमान मे लगभग दू लाख लोक कोढ़ सं प्रभावित छथि, जाहि मे 30 हजार लोक विकलांग भ चुकल छथि। हर साल एहि बीमारी सं संक्रमित लोकक संख्या 2000 सं 2500 धरि अछि.

एखनो मधेश प्रदेश मे १० हजार मे सँ एक सँ बेसी व्यक्ति कोढ़ उत्पन्न करय बला बैक्टीरिया सँ संक्रमित भऽ जाइत अछि ।

महिला, बाल, लैंगिक आ लैंगिक अल्पसंख्यक आ सामाजिक सुरक्षा मन्त्रालयके उपसचिव नीरा अधिकारी विकलांगता बहुआयामी सामाजिक बहसके मुद्दा रहल बतौलनि । अलग-अलग सक्षम लोगऽ क॑ शामिल करना कोनो तकनीकी चुनौती नै बल्कि राजनीतिक आरू नैतिक छै, ई बात प॑ हुनी जोर देलकै ।(आरएसएस)

title: Communist Party of Nepal Faces Internal Strife Over Party Reorganization - Ratopati
description: Communist Party of Nepal Faces Internal Strife Over Party Reorganization  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. The issue of party reorganization has become quite complex within the Communist Party of Nepal (CPN) lately. The Janji movement last year in Bhadra had broken the old power and party structure, and its impact was also felt in the CPN. As the current leadership and party structure are irrelevant in the changed times, youth to old leaders have become active on the issue of party reorganization, transformation, and leadership transfer.

However, although coordinator Pushpa Kamal Dahal 'Prachanda' and co-coordinator Madhav Kumar Nepal appear positive about the issue of party reorganization, they have expressed different opinions regarding leadership transfer. Their argument is that the party cannot be reorganized by disrespectfully removing old leaders who played an important role in building the party. However, they have admitted that they have made mistakes and shortcomings in the past while running the party and the state.

Youth leaders, concluding that the Nepali communist movement has weakened due to focusing only on government formation and dissolution when it was a decisive force in state power, abandoning the class movement and siding with the comprador capitalist bloc, the party's relationship with the people breaking down, a cumbersome organizational structure being built, and the leadership falling into the circle of middlemen and mafias, had launched a reorganization campaign immediately after the elections held in February.

This campaign includes former Prime Minister and senior leader Jhalanath Khanal, former ministers Pampha Bhusal, Shakti Basnet, Chakrapani Khanal, youth leaders Yuvraj Dulal, Ram Prasad Sapkota, Ranjit Tamang, Saral Sahayatri Poudel, Madhav Sapkota, Lekhnath Neupane, among others.

There are two factions regarding party reorganization: whether the leadership should immediately pave the way or reorganize through a general convention by creating rules and procedures.

Former Prime Minister Jhalanath Khanal has concluded that the communist movement will not move forward with Prachanda and Nepal anymore. In Asar, Khanal had submitted a 36-point dissatisfaction letter to coordinator Prachanda. He has advised Prachanda and Nepal to pave the way for party reorganization.

At the party unification and training program organized by the Koshi Province Committee on Saturday, Khanal also called on the youth to lead the party reorganization.

"The CPN must be reorganized. It must be transformed. Youths must come forward saying we will lead, we will train," he said.

He also stated that since a majority within the CPN-UML has also reached the point of reorganization, the CPN also needs it.

Khanal said, "The majority has now reached a point where it needs to be transformed, reorganized within the UML, this is a matter of the era. The same is true for us in the CPN."

At the program, former minister Pampha Bhusal also expressed strong dissatisfaction with the cumbersome party structure. She asserted that a structure of around 2500 people formed by the CPN would not make it a communist party.

"There is no organizational structure that should be in a communist party. Questions are arising as to why I am not included in the 2499-member central committee. This is not the path to becoming a communist party," Bhusal said.

She stated that not only at the center but also the lower committees have become large, leading to a lack of two-way communication.

"The lower committees have become so large that there is almost no two-way communication. Comrades must have many things in their minds, things to express," Bhusal said, "Our committees are not formed in a way that allows for two-way communication. Such organizations are not of communist parties."

Recalling that being a communist in the past meant sacrifice, integrity, and ideals, she clarified that now, on the contrary, aspirations for positions are increasing.

The former CPN Maoist Center, which led the 10-year armed conflict from 2052-62 BS, had merged with 25 leftist components including CPN Unified Socialist, Nepal Socialist, and Nagarik Unmukti Party before the elections. Leaders like Janardan Sharma, Ram Karki, and Suden Kirati had separated, expressing dissatisfaction with the party merger.

The party leadership had expelled seven leaders, including Haribol Gajurel and Kul Prasad KC, on charges of playing a role in defeating the party's official candidate during the elections.

The CPN won a total of 17 seats, eight in direct elections and nine in proportional representation. The CPN, formed by the merger of 25 components, saw its proportional vote decrease from the 11.75 lakh votes received by the former Maoist Center in 2079 BS to 8.11 lakh.

This party, which received nearly 32 lakh popular votes in 2064 BS, has been continuously decreasing its votes since the second Constituent Assembly election in 2070 BS.

काठमांडू। नेपाल कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी (नेकपा) के भीतर पार्टी पुनर्गठन के मुद्दा हाल में काफी जटिल भ गेल अछि । पिछला साल भद्रा मे जंजी आन्दोलन पुरान सत्ता आ पार्टी संरचना के तोड़ि देने छल, आ एकर असर नेकपा मे सेहो महसूस कयल गेल छल । जेना-जेना बदलल समय में वर्तमान नेतृत्व आ पार्टी संरचना अप्रासंगिक अछि, पार्टी के पुनर्गठन, परिवर्तन, आ नेतृत्व स्थानांतरण के मुद्दा पर युवा सं बूढ़ नेता सब सक्रिय भ गेल छथि.

मुदा पार्टी पुनर्गठन के मुद्दा पर संयोजक पुष्पकमल दाहाल ‘प्रचण्ड’ आ सहसंयोजक माधव कुमार नेपाल सकारात्मक देखाइत छथि, मुदा नेतृत्व स्थानांतरण के संबंध मे अलग-अलग विचार व्यक्त केने छथि । हुनकऽ तर्क छै कि पार्टी केरऽ निर्माण म॑ अहम भूमिका निभाबै वाला पुरानऽ नेता सिनी क॑ अनादर करी क॑ हटाय क॑ पार्टी केरऽ पुनर्गठन नै करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै । मुदा पार्टी आ राज्य चलाबैत काल पहिने सेहो गलती आ कमी भेल से स्वीकार केलथि अछि।

राज्य सत्ता मे निर्णायक शक्ति रहला पर नेपाली कम्युनिस्ट आन्दोलन मात्र सरकार गठन आ विघटन पर ध्यान देला सँ, वर्ग आन्दोलन केँ त्यागि कम्पडोर पूँजीवादी ब्लाकक पक्ष मे रहल, जनता सँ पार्टीक संबंध टूटि रहल अछि, बोझिल संगठनात्मक संरचना बनि रहल अछि, आ नेतृत्व बिचौलिया आ माफियाक चक्कर मे खसला सँ कमजोर भ' गेल अछि, ई निष्कर्ष निकालि युवा नेता लोकनि पुनर्गठन अभियान शुरू केने छलाह फरवरी मे भेल चुनाव के तुरंत बाद।

एहि अभियान मे पूर्व प्रधानमंत्री आ वरिष्ठ नेता झलनाथ खनाल, पूर्व मंत्री पम्फा भूसल, शक्ति बस्नेत, चक्रपानी खनाल, युवा नेता युवराज दुलाल, राम प्रसाद सापकोटा, रंजीत तामांग, सरल सहायत्री पौडेल, माधव सापकोटा, लेखनाथ न्यौपाने, आदि शामिल छथि।

पार्टी पुनर्गठन के संबंध में दू गुट छै कि नेतृत्व के तुरंत रास्ता प्रशस्त करलऽ जाय या नियम आरू प्रक्रिया के निर्माण करी क॑ सामान्य अधिवेशन के माध्यम स॑ पुनर्गठन करलऽ जाय ।

पूर्व प्रधानमन्त्री झलनाथ खनाल आब प्रचण्ड आ नेपालक संग कम्युनिस्ट आन्दोलन आगू नहि बढत से निष्कर्ष निकाललनि अछि । आसर मे खनाल संयोजक प्रचण्ड के 36 सूत्री असंतोष पत्र जमा केने छलाह। ओ प्रचण्ड आ नेपाल केँ पार्टी पुनर्गठनक बाट प्रशस्त करबाक सलाह देने छथि ।

शनिदिन कोशी प्रांत समिति द्वारा आयोजित पार्टी एकीकरण आ प्रशिक्षण कार्यक्रम मे खनाल युवा सब स पार्टी पुनर्गठन क नेतृत्व करबाक आह्वान सेहो केलथि।

ओ कहलनि जे, नेकपा के पुनर्गठन करय पड़त, एकर रूपांतरण करय पड़त, युवा सब के नेतृत्व करब, प्रशिक्षण लेब कहैत आगू आबय पड़त।

ओ इहो कहलनि जे, नेकपा एमाले के भीतर बहुमत सेहो पुनर्गठन के बिन्दु पर पहुंच गेल अछि, ताहि लेल नेकपा के सेहो एकर जरूरत अछि।

खनाल कहलनि जे, बहुमत आब एहन बिन्दु पर पहुँचि गेल अछि जतय एकरा एमाले के भीतर परिवर्तन, पुनर्गठन के जरूरत अछि, ई युग के बात अछि, नेकपा मे हमरा सब लेल सेहो इएह बात अछि।

कार्यक्रम मे पूर्व मंत्री पम्फा भुसल सेहो पार्टी के बोझिल संरचना पर कड़ा असंतोष व्यक्त केलनि। ओ नेकपा द्वारा गठित लगभग 2500 लोकक संरचना एकरा कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी नहि बनत ताहि पर जोर देलनि।

भुसल कहलनि जे, एहन कोनो संगठनात्मक संरचना नहि अछि जे कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी मे हेबाक चाही, सवाल उठि रहल अछि जे 2499 सदस्यीय केंद्रीय समिति मे हमरा शामिल किएक नहि अछि, इ कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी बनबाक बाट नहि अछि।

ओ कहली जे केंद्र मे नहि निचला समिति सेहो पैघ भ गेल अछि, जाहि स दुतरफा संवाद क कमी अछि।

भूसल कहलनि जे, निचला समिति एतेक पैघ भ गेल अछि जे लगभग द्विपक्षीय संवाद नहि भ रहल अछि, साथी के दिमाग मे बहुत रास बात होबाक चाही, व्यक्त करय के बात होबाक चाही, हमर समिति एहन नहि बनैत अछि जे दुतरफा संवाद के अनुमति भेटय। एहन संगठन कम्युनिस्ट पार्टी के नहि अछि।

पहिने कम्युनिस्ट होय के मतलब बलिदान, ईमानदारी आरू आदर्श छेलै, ई बात क॑ याद करतें हुअ॑ हुनी स्पष्ट करलकै कि अब॑ एकरऽ विपरीत पदऽ के आकांक्षा बढ़ी रहलऽ छै ।

२०५२-६२ वि.स.सँ १० वर्षक सशस्त्र संघर्षक नेतृत्व करय बला नेकपा माओवादी केन्द्र निर्वाचनसँ पहिने नेकपा एकीकृत समाजवादी, नेपाल समाजवादी, आ नगरिक उन्मुक्ति पार्टी सहित २५ वामपक्षीय घटकमे विलय भेल छल । जनार्दन शर्मा, राम कार्की, आ सुदेन किराती सन नेता पार्टी विलय पर असंतोष व्यक्त करैत अलग भ गेल छलाह ।

पार्टी नेतृत्व चुनाव के दौरान पार्टी के आधिकारिक उम्मीदवार के हराबै में भूमिका निभाबय के आरोप में हरिबोल गजुरेल आ कुल प्रसाद केसी सहित सात नेता के निष्कासित केने छल।

नेकपा कुल १७ सीट, प्रत्यक्ष निर्वाचनमे ८ आ आनुपातिक प्रतिनिधित्वमे ९ सीट जीतल अछि । 25 घटक के विलय स बनल नेकपा के आनुपातिक मत पूर्व माओवादी केन्द्र के 2079 बीएस मे भेटल 11.75 लाख मत स घटि क 8.11 लाख भ गेल अछि।

title: All criminal cases are in institutional memory of Nepal Police: IGP Karki - The Rising Nepal
description: All criminal cases are in institutional memory of Nepal Police: IGP Karki  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug. 23: Inspector General (IG) of Nepal Police Dan Bahadur Karki has said that anyone involved in criminal cases would be brought to justice anytime as all sorts of criminal activities happened in the society are in institutional memory of the Nepal Police.

Talking to the RSS, the Nepal Police Chief said that the criminals have been booked even after decades of the crimes and the police organization would not forget such cases.

"People's memories fade in a short time. But, Nepal Police is an institution to relentlessly fight for the justice of individuals. This organization would not forget such cases," Karki added.

However, Karki admitted that the police organization has not achieved the expected successes.

The Nepal Police brings the perpetrators under the ambit of law through the studies and frequent investigation processes, Karki added.

He also stated that the Nepal Police was carrying out investigations in the notorious cases of the past by forming special teams and added that the police organization has achieved good success in some cases.

Likewise, Karki added that investigations on some notorious criminal cases of the past were on-going through the Central Investigation Bureau (CIB). "We have advanced investigations of the new and past cases simultaneously," he added.(RSS)

title: Nainsingh Mahar proposes three options to Deuba to prevent split in Nepali Congress - Khabarhub
description: Nainsingh Mahar proposes three options to Deuba to prevent split in Nepali Congress  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Nepali Congress youth leader Nainsingh Mahar has presented three proposals to former party president Sher Bahadur Deuba to resolve the growing internal dispute within the party.

During a meeting with Deuba on Sunday morning, Mahar stressed the need to resolve the dispute through immediate dialogue and consensus.

Mahar met Deuba after the former party president returned to Nepal following a prolonged medical treatment. He said the party could not move forward while remaining embroiled in internal conflict and urged the senior leadership to take the initiative to resolve the situation.

“I have proposed that the party should be united and move forward. I made three proposals to unite the party, and he also said they were right,” Mahar said.

Mahar’s first proposal is to arrange an immediate direct dialogue between party president Gagan Thapa and former president Deuba to resolve the ongoing dispute. He believes other contentious issues could also be settled through consensus once dialogue begins between the two leaders.

As his second option, Mahar proposed that both Gagan Thapa and Sher Bahadur Deuba step aside from the leadership and agree to a third person as the party’s leader, followed by the 15th General Convention. He said this could provide a new political settlement to the current leadership dispute.

Mahar’s third proposal concerns the Congress dispute currently under consideration by the court. He proposed that both sides should accept the court’s final verdict regardless of which side it favours, while resolving the party’s internal disputes through dialogue and consensus before the verdict is delivered.

“My proposal is that we should discuss and resolve all issues through dialogue and consensus before the court delivers its final verdict. Whatever the court ultimately decides, we should accept it,” Mahar said.

Former president Deuba has been meeting party leaders and cadres regularly since returning to Nepal on August 13. According to Mahar, Deuba has also been expressing his desire to keep the party united and move forward together.

Mahar said he informed Deuba that party president Gagan Thapa also wanted to meet him. According to Mahar, Deuba indicated that he was ready to work toward reconciliation.

“I told him that President Gagan Thapa wants to meet you and that we need to bring the party together. He said there was no problem and that the party should be united,” Mahar said.

However, Mahar said Deuba also believes that the court’s decision should be awaited as the Congress dispute has already reached the judiciary. According to him, Deuba appears open to both dialogue and waiting for the court’s verdict.

“His position is that we should hold dialogue while also waiting for the court’s decision,” Mahar said.

With disputes over leadership, the General Convention and the party’s legal status intensifying within the Nepali Congress, Mahar has been holding discussions with leaders from both sides in an effort to find a consensus.

His three proposals seek to provide three possible routes to resolve the crisis: direct dialogue between the top leaders, alternative leadership followed by the 15th General Convention, and consensus while accepting the court’s final decision.

अपनऽ दोसरऽ विकल्प के रूप म॑ महर न॑ प्रस्ताव रखलकै कि गगन थापा आरू शेरबहादुर देउबा दोनों नेतृत्व स॑ अलग होय क॑ पार्टी केरऽ नेता के रूप म॑ तेसरऽ व्यक्ति क॑ सहमत होय जाय, जेकरा बाद १५वां आम अधिवेशन होय ​​। ओ कहलनि जे, एहि सं वर्तमान नेतृत्व विवाद के नव राजनीतिक निपटारा भ सकैत अछि।

महर केरऽ तेसरऽ प्रस्ताव कांग्रेस विवाद स॑ संबंधित छै जेकरा प॑ अभी कोर्ट द्वारा विचार करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै । ओ प्रस्ताव रखलनि जे दुनू पक्ष के कोर्ट के अंतिम फैसला के स्वीकार करबाक चाही चाहे ओ कोनो पक्ष के पक्ष मे हो, जखन कि फैसला देबय सं पहिने पार्टी के आंतरिक विवाद के बातचीत आओर सहमति सं निपटय के चाही.

महर कहलनि जे, हुनकर स्थिति अछि जे कोर्ट के फैसला के इंतजार सेहो करैत हमरा सब के संवाद करबाक चाही।

full_article:
Lukla — the runway every Everest trekker has to survive first

Before any trekker sets foot on the trail to Everest Base Camp, they typically have to survive Lukla first. Tenzing-Hillary Airport sits at 2,845 metres, its single asphalt runway just 527 metres long and sloping at nearly 12 percent — aircraft land uphill to help them stop, and take off downhill to help them get airborne, because there simply isn't room for a conventional runway on this Himalayan mountain shelf. A sheer wall sits at one end, a steep drop into the valley at the other, and pilots get essentially one attempt: there's no room to abort a landing partway through. Renamed in 2008 to honour Sir Edmund Hillary and Tenzing Norgay, the first two men to summit Everest in 1953, the airport now carries over 30,000 trekkers a year through what is widely regarded as the most demanding commercial airstrip on Earth.

Down in the valley, Kathmandu tells a different kind of high-stakes story. The city's seven UNESCO-listed monument zones, including the Durbar Squares of Kathmandu, Patan and Bhaktapur and the stupas of Swayambhunath and Boudhanath, were inscribed as a single World Heritage property in 1979 — the same year Sagarmatha National Park, home to Everest itself, was also listed. Both sites suffered heavily in the devastating magnitude-7.8 earthquake of 25 April 2015, which damaged 447 monuments across the valley, destroyed dozens completely, and severely affected the Everest region's own infrastructure — a reminder that both of Nepal's great World Heritage landscapes, mountain and city alike, sit on genuinely unstable ground.
