It's one of several live feeds across the region that turn a scientific outpost into an accidental window on the Himalayas for viewers thousands of kilometres away.

Nepal beyond the webcams

Sagarmatha National Park: the Everest region's UNESCO-listed park, home to the world's highest peak and the Sherpa communities who live within it.

Kathmandu Durbar Square: the historic royal palace complex at the heart of the Kathmandu Valley's seven monument zones.

Swayambhunath: the hilltop Buddhist stupa overlooking Kathmandu, nicknamed the "Monkey Temple."

Every trekker heading to the roof of the world first has to land on one of its narrowest ledges — a 527-metre runway wedged between a cliff and a mountain wall. Nepal's two great World Heritage landscapes, the mountains and the valley below them, both demand the same kind of respect from anyone who visits.

When to watch

Early morning: for the clearest mountain visibility and the first Lukla flights of the day, before afternoon clouds typically roll in.

Getting there: Lukla is reached by a short flight from Kathmandu, and serves as the starting point for treks into the Everest region, Solukhumbu District, Nepal.

कोनो ट्रेकर के एवरेस्ट बेस कैंप के निशान पर पैर रखबा सं पहिने आम तौर पर पहिने लुकला सं बचय पड़ैत छनि. टेनजिंग-हिलेरी हवाई अड्डा 2,845 मीटर पर बैसल अछि, एकर एकल डामर रनवे मात्र 527 मीटर लंबा आ लगभग 12 प्रतिशत ढलान — विमान ओकरा रुकबा में मदद करबाक लेल ऊपर उतरैत अछि, आ हवा में चढ़बा में मदद करबाक लेल नीचा उतरैत अछि, कारण बस एहि हिमालयी पहाड़ी शेल्फ पर पारंपरिक रनवे के जगह नहिं अछि. एक छोर पर एकटा सरासर देबाल बैसल अछि, दोसर छोर पर घाटी में खड़ी बूंद, आ पायलट सब कें अनिवार्य रूप सं एकटा प्रयास भेटैत छैक : आधा रास्ता में लैंडिंग कें गर्भपात करबाक कोनो गुंजाइश नहिं. 2008 म॑ एकरऽ नाम बदली क॑ सर एडमंड हिलेरी आरू टेनजिंग नोर्गे के सम्मान म॑ रखलऽ गेलऽ छेलै, जे 1953 म॑ एवरेस्ट केरऽ शिखर प॑ पहुँचै वाला पहलऽ दू आदमी छेलै, ई हवाई अड्डा अब॑ साल म॑ 30,000 स॑ भी अधिक ट्रेकर्स क॑ पहुँचै छै, जेकरा व्यापक रूप स॑ पृथ्वी प॑ सबसें मांग वाला वाणिज्यिक हवाई पट्टी मानलऽ जाय छै ।

घाटी के नीचा काठमांडू एकटा अलग तरहक हाई-स्टेक कहानी कहैत अछि. शहर केरऽ यूनेस्को म॑ सूचीबद्ध सात स्मारक क्षेत्र, जेकरा म॑ काठमांडू, पाटन आरू भक्तपुर केरऽ दरबार चौक आरू स्वयंभूनाथ आरू बौधानाथ केरऽ स्तूप शामिल छै, क॑ १९७९ म॑ एकल विश्व धरोहर संपत्ति के रूप म॑ अंकित करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै — यही साल खुद एवरेस्ट केरऽ घर सागरमाथा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान क॑ भी सूचीबद्ध करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै । २५ अप्रैल २०१५ क॑ ७.८ तीव्रता केरऽ विनाशकारी भूकंप म॑ दोनों स्थलऽ क॑ बहुत नुकसान पहुँचलै, जेकरा स॑ घाटी भर म॑ ४४७ स्मारकऽ क॑ नुकसान पहुँचलै, दर्जनों स्मारकऽ क॑ पूरा तरह स॑ नष्ट होय गेलै, आरू एवरेस्ट क्षेत्र केरऽ अपनऽ बुनियादी ढाँचा क॑ गंभीर रूप स॑ प्रभावित करलकै — ई याद दिलाबै छै कि नेपाल केरऽ दोनों महान विश्व धरोहर परिदृश्य, पहाड़ आरू शहर दोनों ही बैठलऽ छै वास्तविक रूप स अस्थिर जमीन।

Kathmandu. Main highways in various provinces of the country have been affected due to continuous rain, floods, and landslides.

As of 06:20 AM on Monday, roads have been completely or partially obstructed in various places.

In Koshi Province, the Mid-Hill Highway in Bokhim, Bhojpur, is operating one-way due to floods. In the Rajduwali area of Ilam, the Jhapa-Taplejung road section of the Mechi Highway is completely blocked due to landslides. Police have stated that alternative routes can be used in both places.

Risk has increased on roads in Bagmati Province, leading to strict traffic control. On the BP Highway in Kavre, all vehicles are prohibited from operating from 06:00 PM to 04:00 AM. On the Kanti Lokpath's Hetauda-Thingan-Bagmati-Lalitpur road section, night-time vehicle operation is also banned from 05:00 PM to 05:00 AM.

In Sindhupalchok, the Arniko Highway in Kodari and Liping, and in Rasuwa, the Trishuli-Mailung-Syaphru Bensi at Khalte and the Pasang Lhamu road section including Syau Parki are completely blocked due to landslides and floods. The Shivapuri Tokha-Chhahare road section in Nuwakot is also closed for vehicles from 10:00 PM to 05:00 AM.

On the main highways of Gandaki Province, although landslides have occurred, vehicles are operating one-way. The Kaligandaki Corridor in Belbaga, Baglung, the Beni-Jomsom road at Kaiku Khola, Mustang, and the Chame-Besishahar road section in Khotro, Manang are operating one-way.

In Karnali Province, the Jajarkot-Dolpa road section has been completely blocked due to floods in Rijegard Khola, Rukum Paschim.

title: Nepali Congress Faces Internal Division Ahead of Convention - ABC NEWS NEPAL
description: Nepali Congress Faces Internal Division Ahead of Convention  ABC NEWS NEPAL
publisher.title: ABC NEWS NEPAL
full_article:
Kathmandu— Nepal’s Nepali Congress (NC) is experiencing significant internal strife following last year’s Gen Z movement and subsequent general elections, which signaled public dissatisfaction with existing governance. The party, historically a key agent of change in the country, now finds itself deeply divided between an establishment faction led by Gagan Kumar Thapa and an anti-establishment group headed by former president Sher Bahadur Deuba, who are contesting the legitimacy of the current leadership and control over the upcoming 15th general convention scheduled for October 2026.

The Role of Political Parties

A strong relationship exists between political parties and democratic systems; parties thrive within democracies and are essential to their function. Throughout history, they have often led struggles against autocratic regimes in favor of establishing democratic governance, providing citizens with platforms for advocating freedom, equality, and human rights. In a functioning democracy, these parties serve as vital links between the government and the populace, earning votes based on performance both in power and opposition.

Electoral Discontent and Party Response

Last year’s protests led by Gen Z highlighted issues of bad governance, corruption, political syndicates, and unemployment, contributing to a desire for change reflected in recent elections. While the electorate sought new leadership through these polls, electoral losses have triggered internal rifts within some parties, particularly Nepali Congress. The party has struggled to institutionalize past achievements and deliver tangible improvements to citizens’ lives, leading to recurring unrest.

Leadership Dispute Intensifies

The current division within NC stems from a disagreement over the legitimacy of a Special Convention that elected Gagan Kumar Thapa as president; Sher Bahadur Deuba's faction contests its validity. A Supreme Court review petition filed by Deuba and Purna Bahadur Khadka has further fueled the conflict, with the anti-establishment group anticipating a reversal of the court’s recognition of the Thapa-led central working committee. Both factions are now at odds over control of the 15th general convention.

Calls for Unity

Supporters of the Special Convention maintain it reflects public demand for reform and generational leadership change, claiming over half of party representatives backed the move. Despite the deep divisions, voices within the party advocate for unity, emphasizing that strong and unified parties are essential to fulfilling promises made to the electorate. Reconciliation and finding common ground between the factions are seen as crucial steps forward.

The future direction of Nepali Congress remains uncertain as the dispute over leadership continues, with both sides awaiting a potential ruling from the Supreme Court that could reshape the party’s structure and influence its upcoming convention.

राजनीतिक दलों की भूमिका

चुनावी असंतोष एवं पार्टी प्रतिक्रिया

नेतृत्व विवाद तेज

नेकां के भीतर वर्तमान विभाजन एकटा विशेष अधिवेशन के वैधता पर असहमति स उपजल अछि जाहि में गगन कुमार थापा के अध्यक्ष चुनल गेल छल; शेर बहादुर देउबा के गुट एकर वैधता के मुकाबला करैत अछि । देउबा आरू पूर्णबहादुर खड्का द्वारा दायर सुप्रीम कोर्ट केरऽ समीक्षा याचिका न॑ द्वंद्व क॑ आरू तेज करी देल॑ छै, जेकरा म॑ संस्थापन विरोधी समूह न॑ थापा नेतृत्व वाला केन्द्रीय कार्यसमिति क॑ कोर्ट केरऽ मान्यता उलटै के उम्मीद करी रहलऽ छै । आब 15म आम अधिवेशन पर नियंत्रण पर दुनू गुट मे विवाद अछि।

एकता के आह्वान

विशेष अधिवेशन केरऽ समर्थकऽ के कहना छै कि ई सुधार आरू पीढ़ी के नेतृत्व परिवर्तन केरऽ जन मांग क॑ दर्शाबै छै, आरू दावा करलऽ गेलऽ छै कि पार्टी केरऽ आधा स॑ अधिक प्रतिनिधि न॑ ई कदम के समर्थन करलकै । गहींर विभाजन के बावजूद पार्टी के भीतर आवाज एकता के वकालत करै छै, जेकरा म॑ ई बात प॑ जोर देलऽ जाय छै कि मतदाता स॑ करलऽ गेलऽ वादा पूरा करै लेली मजबूत आरू एकजुट पार्टी जरूरी छै । गुटऽ के बीच सुलह आरू आम जमीन खोजना आगू के महत्वपूर्ण कदम के रूप म॑ देखलऽ जाय छै ।

title: Nepal-India Border Dispute: Meetings Yield No Decision on Lipulekh - Ratopati
description: Nepal-India Border Dispute: Meetings Yield No Decision on Lipulekh  Ratopati
publisher.title: Ratopati
full_article:
Kathmandu. Since the formation of the government under Prime Minister Balendra Shah, two main joint meetings have been held with India regarding border issues.

The meeting of the Nepal-India Survey Officials Committee was held on July 29 in Lucknow, India, and the meeting of the Joint Working Group on Border Management was held on August 4 in Dehradun, India. Attention was focused on these two important meetings amidst the ongoing border dispute between Nepal and India.

However, neither of these meetings made any decision on the issue of Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura, and Kalapani. Due to the unresolved problem of this land, which has been disputed for a long time, conflicts always escalate between the two countries on the border issue. Although it is said to be resolved through diplomatic talks, no concrete initiative has been found from anywhere so far for a solution.

The meeting of the Survey Officials Committee held on July 29 agreed to survey the land claimed to be encroached by each other between Nepal and India. After Prime Minister Balendra Shah expressed that not only India has encroached on Nepal's land but Nepal has also encroached on India's land, an agreement was reached to investigate the land that both countries have been occupying.

After the Prime Minister's statement, the Ministry of Foreign Affairs also issued a statement clarifying that due to the adoption of certain border principles in riverine areas during the determination of the Nepal-India border, 'cross-border occupation' has occurred, leading to a situation where citizens of one country cultivate and reside on land within the territory of the other country.

Although both countries agreed to study those lands and resolve the dispute, nothing has been said about Lipulekh, which is the biggest dispute. An official from the Survey Department, who participated in the meeting, said that the committee was not even given the mandate (authority) to study or discuss Lipulekh. He informed that during the two-day meeting held in India, neither side even discussed this issue.

According to him, Lipulekh is a very sensitive issue, and it cannot be resolved without high-level intervention. He stated that lower-level employees do not want to take risks regarding the disputed Lipulekh. He warned that if this is not resolved soon, it could take a more serious turn, saying, 'We cannot say that another mess won't happen there tomorrow, so it is better to resolve it as soon as possible.'

This too ‘The Lipulekh dispute is not technical, it must be resolved politically and diplomatically’

Dehradun Meeting

In the meeting of the Joint Working Group held in Dehradun on August 4 and 5, although Lipulekh was informally raised, it was stated that it was not discussed as an agenda item. Instead, the working group decided to increase surveillance and strictness on the Nepal-India border.

This too Strict surveillance will be carried out on the Nepal-India border

The meeting discussed facilitating cross-border movement of citizens of both countries, increasing surveillance of third-country nationals, disaster management, and repair of damaged border pillars. However, no decision was made on Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura, and Kalapani.

According to border scholar Ratna Bhandari, the Lipulekh dispute has now become a political dispute between the two countries. He states that because it is being used as a political tool, no one is showing interest in resolving it. He said, 'Specifically, India does not want to resolve it, and Nepal has also not shown sufficient interest, which is why the dispute has not been resolved so far.'

Bhandari stated that during the India-China war in 1962 (1966 according to the text), India placed its army there after asking Nepal. Since then, India has not removed its army from there under various pretexts and has now started claiming that land as its own.

If we trace the root of the Lipulekh dispute, we have to go back to the Sugauli Treaty of 1816. The modern Kalapani dispute became serious after 1962. Diplomatic disputes between Nepal and India over Lipulekh began in 2015. Only after India released its new map in 2020, including Lipulekh, Kalapani, and Limpiyadhura, did the Nepali government become serious and start showing interest in that territory.

Beginning of the Dispute

According to a former secretary of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, although the Lipulekh dispute is very old, governments during the Panchayat and multiparty eras never took it seriously. Although the Mahakali and Kalapani rivers were raised during surveys from Nepal's side, the issue was never formally raised at the government level. Even though India kept its army there, it did not engage in much activity initially. However, Nepal became alarmed only after an agreement was made to build a road through Nepali territory for trade with China and for pilgrimage to Mansarovar, he said.

The former secretary stated that the main reason India claims that territory as its own is that it has been using that land for a long time. If interest had been shown from the beginning and efforts made to remove the Indian army, the issue would not have reached such a serious stage today.

When the then President of the Nepali Congress, Sushil Koirala, was the Prime Minister, he assigned the task of technically resolving the issues of Lipulekh, Limpiyadhura, and Kalapani through discussions with India to the Survey Department. However, the Survey Department, not wanting to take the blame, sent a letter to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs stating that a committee would be formed at the level of foreign secretaries of both countries for discussions, and the department would only provide technical support. Subsequently, a committee was formed with the Foreign Secretary of Nepal during the visit of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, but its meeting has not yet been held.

Land Swap

Moreover, the Survey Department also suggested swapping land between the two countries to resolve the dispute. Lipulekh Pass is as important for India as it is strategically less important for Nepal. There may be no better place for Nepal to monitor China than that territory. Therefore, the department suggested leaving that land to India and demanding land from Darjeeling to Bangladesh (Chicken's Neck area) from India in return.

The Survey Department had suggested to the then Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs that Nepal could also consider the option of a land swap if India was willing to do so, as Nepal would also gain access to the sea. However, an official from the department said that no one raised this issue with the Indian side at that time.

Various committees and working groups related to the border are active between Nepal and India, and their meetings are held regularly. Meetings are also being held at the district level, but the meeting of the committee formed to resolve the dispute over Lipulekh, Kalapani, and Limpiyadhura has not been held. Former Director General of the Survey Department, Nagendra Jha, says, 'India has not shown interest in holding the meeting. Even if Nepal makes efforts, India evades it by making various excuses.'

Issues Not Raised in Working Groups

Based on the depth of the rivers, historical documents clearly indicate that Lipulekh, Kalapani, and Limpiyadhura are Nepali territories. However, the dispute has arisen because India is claiming the border based on the rivers changing their course, Jha said. He stated that although there are various committees and mechanisms between the two countries, the issues are not progressing because these working groups have not been given the mandate to discuss Lipulekh.

Informed sources say that the issue has become more controversial recently after Prime Minister Balen stated that not only India but also Nepal has encroached on India's land. They argue that this has made it easier for India to maintain its stance. Similarly, the border dispute has become more complex after Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal stated that the Nepali government does not possess the original copy of the Sugauli Treaty and is searching for it.

However, Ratna Bhandari, who has written a book on the Lipulekh issue, says, 'The absence of the original copy of the Sugauli Treaty does not create problems in discussions; Nepal has sufficient historical evidence based on which it can negotiate strongly with India.'

India-China Agreement and Nepal's Objection

India claims to have been trading with China via Lipulekh Pass since 1954. However, Nepal officially began objecting to this in 1999. Nepal protested after an agreement was reached during the visit of then Indian Foreign Minister Jaswant Singh to China in 1999 to make Lipulekh a common trade route for both countries.

Subsequently, in 2005, China and India also reached a 12-point agreement. In that agreement, titled 'Modalities for the Implementation of Confidence Building Measures in the Military Field Along the Line of Actual Control in the India-China Border Areas,' both sides agreed to expand the mechanism of border meeting points by including Lipulekh/Changla Bhanjyang in the middle sector and Kibithu-Dhamai in the eastern sector. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Nepal protested by sending diplomatic notes to both countries at that time.

During the visit of Chinese President Xi Jinping to India in 2014, an agreement was reached to open a new route for the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra. According to officials from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Nepal did not react much at that time. However, Nepal strongly protested when India and China reached an agreement regarding Lipulekh again during Prime Minister Narendra Modi's visit to China in 2015. Then Prime Minister Sushil Koirala sent diplomatic notes to both India and China.

Instead of responding, India included Lipulekh, Kalapani, and Limpiyadhura in its map. Despite widespread protests, India ignored them and inaugurated a road in the area. Subsequently, KP Sharma Oli, who became Prime Minister, unveiled a new map including Lipulekh, Kalapani, and Limpiyadhura, got it passed by parliament, and incorporated it into the constitution.

This created a rift in Nepal-India relations for some time, and the issue of Lipulekh became a matter of public concern. Since then, the issue has been raised during the tenure of every government.

During Indian National Security Advisor Ajit Doval's visit to China in December 2024, an agreement was reached to resume the Kailash Mansarovar Yatra via the Lipulekh route. The 12-point agreement reached during Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi's visit to India on August 18, 2025, also mentioned starting border trade via Lipulekh.

There was significant protest in Nepal regarding this, and the government also sent diplomatic notes to both countries. Both countries have sent their responses, but while the dispute remains unresolved, trade activities continue to move forward.

देहरादून बैसार

4 आरू 5 अगस्त क॑ देहरादून म॑ आयोजित संयुक्त कार्यदल केरऽ बैठक म॑ हालांकि लिपुलेख क॑ अनौपचारिक रूप स॑ उठाबै के बात कहलऽ गेलै, लेकिन एकरा प॑ एजेंडा के रूप म॑ चर्चा नै करलऽ गेलै । बल्कि कार्यदल नेपाल-भारत सीमा पर निगरानी आ सख्ती बढ़ेबाक निर्णय लेलक ।

ईहो नेपाल-भारत सीमा पर सख्त निगरानी कएल जाएत

सीमा विद्वान रत्न भण्डारी के अनुसार लिपुलेख विवाद आब दुनु देश के बीच राजनीतिक विवाद बनि गेल अछि । हुनकऽ कहना छै कि एकरऽ इस्तेमाल राजनीतिक औजार के रूप म॑ करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै, ई लेली एकरऽ समाधान म॑ कोय भी रुचि नै दिखाय रहलऽ छै । ओ कहलनि जे, विशेष रूप सं भारत एकर समाधान नहि करय चाहैत अछि, आ नेपाल सेहो पर्याप्त रुचि नहि देखौलक अछि, जाहि कारणे एखन धरि विवादक समाधान नहि भ सकल अछि।'

भण्डारी कहलनि जे, 1962 मे भारत-चीन युद्धक समय (पाठक अनुसार 1966) भारत नेपाल सँ पूछलाक बाद अपन सेना ओतय राखि देलक । तहिया सँ भारत विभिन्न बहाने ओतय सँ अपन सेना नहि हटा देलक आ आब ओहि जमीन केँ अपन दावा करय लागल अछि।

अगर लिपुलेख विवाद के जड़ के पता लगाबी त 1816 के सुगौली संधि में वापस जाय पड़त।आधुनिक कलापानी विवाद 1962 के बाद गंभीर भ गेल।लिपुलेख के ल क नेपाल आ भारत के बीच कूटनीतिक विवाद 2015 में शुरू भेल।भारत 2020 में अपन नव नक्शा जारी केलाक बाद मात्र, जाहि में लिपुलेख, कालापानी, आ लिम्पियाधुरा, की नेपाली सरकार गंभीर भ' ओहि इलाका मे रुचि देखाबय लागल.

विवाद के शुरुआत

विदेश मंत्रालय क एकटा पूर्व सचिव क अनुसार लिपुलेख विवाद भले बहुत पुरान अछि, मुदा पंचायत आ बहुदलीय युग मे सरकार एकरा कहियो गंभीरता स नहि लेलक। ओना नेपाल दिस स सर्वेक्षण क दौरान महाकाली आ कालापानी नदी उठल मुदा सरकारी स्तर पर कहियो औपचारिक रूप स इ मुद्दा नहि उठल। भारत अपन सेना ओतहि राखि लेलक मुदा शुरू मे बेसी गतिविधि नहि केलक । मुदा चीन के संग व्यापार आ मनसरोवर के तीर्थयात्रा के लेल नेपाली इलाका स सड़क बनेबाक समझौता भेलाक बाद नेपाल घबरा गेल ओ कहलनि।

पूर्व सचिव के कहनाय छनि जे भारत ओहि इलाका के अपन दावा करय के मुख्य कारण ई अछि जे ओ ओहि जमीन के बहुत दिन सं उपयोग क रहल अछि. अगर शुरूए स रुचि देखाउल गेल रहैत आ भारतीय सेना कए हटाबय क प्रयास कैल जाइत त आइ इ मुद्दा एतेक गंभीर अवस्था मे नहि पहुंचल रहैत।

नेपाली कांग्रेसक तत्कालीन अध्यक्ष सुशील कोइराला जखन प्रधानमंत्री छलाह तखन भारतक संग चर्चाक माध्यमे लिपुलेख, लिम्पियाधुरा, आ कालापानीक मुद्दा केँ तकनीकी रूप सँ समाधान करबाक काज सर्वेक्षण विभाग केँ देलनि । लेकिन सर्वेक्षण विभाग एकरऽ दोष नै लेबै चाहला स॑ विदेश मंत्रालय क॑ एगो चिट्ठी भेजलकै जेकरा म॑ कहलऽ गेलऽ छेलै कि चर्चा लेली दोनों देशऽ के विदेश सचिवऽ के स्तर प॑ एगो समिति के गठन करलऽ जैतै, आरू विभाग खाली तकनीकी सहायता देतै । तत्पश्चात भारतीय प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीक यात्रामे नेपालक विदेश सचिवक संग समिति गठन कएल गेल, मुदा ओकर बैसार एखन धरि नहि भेल अछि ।

भूमि अदला-बदली

एतबे नहि सर्वेक्षण विभाग एहि विवाद क समाधान लेल दुनू देश क बीच जमीन क अदला-बदली क सेहो सुझाव देलक। लिपुलेख दर्रा भारत के लेल ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण अछि जतेक नेपाल के लेल सामरिक रूप स कम। चीन पर नजरि रखबा लेल नेपाल लेल ओहि इलाका स नीक कोनो जगह नहि भ सकैत अछि। एहि लेल विभाग ओ जमीन भारत पर छोड़बाक आ बदला मे भारत स दार्जिलिंग स बांग्लादेश (चिकन नेक एरिया) क जमीन मांगबाक सुझाव देलक।

सर्वेक्षण विभाग तत्कालीन प्रधानमंत्री आ विदेश मंत्री कए सुझाव देने छल जे भारत इच्छुक रहला पर नेपाल सेहो भूमि अदला-बदली क विकल्प पर विचार क सकैत अछि, किया कि नेपाल कए सेहो समुद्र तक पहुंच भेटत। ओना विभाग क एकटा अधिकारी कहला जे ओहि समय भारतीय पक्ष स इ मुद्दा कियो नहि उठेलक।

नेपाल आ भारत के बीच सीमा स संबंधित विभिन्न समिति आ कार्यदल सक्रिय अछि, आ ओकर बैसार नियमित रूप स होइत अछि । जिला स्तर पर सेहो बैसार भ रहल अछि, मुदा लिपुलेख, कालापानी, आ लिम्पियाधुरा के विवाद सुलझाबय लेल बनल समिति के बैसार नहि भेल अछि. सर्वेक्षण विभागक पूर्व महानिदेशक नागेन्द्र झा कहैत छथि, ‘भारत एहि बैसार करबा मे रुचि नहि देखौलक अछि। नेपाल प्रयास करै तबो भारत विभिन्न बहाना बना कऽ टालैत अछि ।'

कार्यदल मे नहि उठल मुद्दा

नदी सब के गहराई के आधार पर ऐतिहासिक दस्तावेज स स्पष्ट संकेत भेटैत अछि जे लिपुलेख, कालापानी, आ लिम्पियाधुरा नेपाली क्षेत्र अछि | ओना विवाद एहि लेल उठल अछि जे भारत नदी क रस्ता बदलबाक आधार पर सीमा पर दावा क रहल अछि, झा कहला। हुनी कहलकै कि हालांकि दूनू देश के बीच विभिन्न समिति आरू तंत्र छै, लेकिन मुद्दा आगू नै बढ़ी रहलौ छै, कैन्हेंकि ई कार्यदल क लिपुलेख प चर्चा करै के जनादेश नै देलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

सूचित सूत्रक कहब अछि जे, प्रधानमंत्री बालेन भारते नहि, नेपाल सेहो भारतक जमीन पर अतिक्रमण केने कहला के बाद हाल मे ई मुद्दा बेसी विवादित भ गेल अछि। हुनकऽ तर्क छै कि एकरा स॑ भारत क॑ अपनऽ रुख कायम रखै म॑ आसानी होय गेलऽ छै । तहिना विदेश मंत्री शिशिर खनाल नेपाली सरकार लग सुगौली संधिक मूल प्रति नहि अछि आ ओकर खोज मे लागल अछि से कहला के बाद सीमा विवाद आओर जटिल भ गेल अछि ।

मुदा, लिपुलेख मुद्दा पर पोथी लिखनिहार रत्न भण्डारी कहैत छथि, 'सुगौली संधिक मूल प्रतिक अभाव मे चर्चा मे समस्या नहि उत्पन्न होइत छैक; नेपाल के पास पर्याप्त ऐतिहासिक प्रमाण छै, जेकरा आधार पर भारत के साथ मजबूती स॑ बातचीत करी सकै छै ।'

भारत-चीन सम्झौता आ नेपालक आपत्ति

भारत के दावा छै कि चीन के साथ लिपुलेख दर्रा के माध्यम स॑ १९५४ स॑ व्यापार करी रहलऽ छै ।मुदा नेपाल न॑ आधिकारिक तौर प॑ १९९९ म॑ एकरा प॑ आपत्ति करना शुरू करी देलकै ।१९९९ म॑ तत्कालीन भारतीय विदेश मंत्री जसवंत सिंह केरऽ चीन यात्रा के दौरान लिपुलेख क॑ दूनू देश लेली साझा व्यापारिक मार्ग बनाबै के समझौता होय के बाद नेपाल न॑ एकरऽ विरोध करलकै ।

एकरऽ बाद २००५ म॑ चीन आरू भारत के बीच भी १२ सूत्री समझौता होय गेलै । ‘भारत-चीन सीमा क्षेत्रऽ म॑ वास्तविक नियंत्रण के रेखा के साथ सैन्य क्षेत्र म॑ विश्वास निर्माण के उपायऽ के कार्यान्वयन के तरीका’ शीर्षक स॑ बनलऽ वू समझौता म॑ दूनू पक्ष न॑ मध्य क्षेत्र म॑ लिपुलेख/चांगला भंजयांग आरू पूर्वी क्षेत्र म॑ किबिथु-धमाई क॑ शामिल करी क॑ सीमा बैठक बिंदु के तंत्र क॑ विस्तारित करै प॑ सहमत होय गेलै । नेपालक विदेश मन्त्रालय ओहि समय दुनू देश मे कूटनीतिक नोट पठा क विरोध केलक ।

2014 में चीन के राष्ट्रपति शी जिनपिंग के भारत यात्रा के दौरान कैलाश मनसरोवर यात्रा के लेल एकटा नव मार्ग खोलय के समझौता भेल छल. विदेश मंत्रालय के अधिकारी के अनुसार ओहि समय नेपाल मे कोनो खास प्रतिक्रिया नहि छल. मुदा २०१५ मे प्रधानमन्त्री नरेन्द्र मोदीक चीन यात्राक क्रममे भारत आ चीन पुनः लिपुलेखक संबंधमे सहमति भेला पर नेपाल कड़ा विरोध केलक ।तखन प्रधानमन्त्री सुशील कोइराला भारत आ चीन दुनू दिस कूटनीतिक नोट पठौलनि ।

भारत प्रतिक्रिया देबाक बदला अपन नक्शा मे लिपुलेख, कालापानी, आ लिम्पियाधुरा के शामिल केलक । व्यापक विरोध के बावजूद भारत हुनका सब के अनदेखी क एहि इलाका मे एकटा सड़क के उद्घाटन केलक। एकरऽ बाद प्रधानमंत्री बनला केपी शर्मा ओली न॑ लिपुलेख, कालापानी, आरू लिम्पियाधुरा सहित एगो नया नक्शा के अनावरण करी क॑ संसद स॑ पारित करी क॑ संविधान म॑ शामिल करी लेलकै ।

एहि सँ नेपाल-भारत संबंध मे किछु समय धरि दरार उत्पन्न भेल, आ लिपुलेखक मुद्दा जनसरोकारक विषय बनि गेल । तहिया स इ मुद्दा हर सरकार क कार्यकाल मे उठल अछि।

दिसंबर २०२४ म॑ भारतीय राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सलाहकार अजीत डोवल केरऽ चीन यात्रा के दौरान लिपुलेख मार्ग के माध्यम स॑ कैलाश मनसरोवर यात्रा क॑ फेर स॑ शुरू करै के समझौता होय गेलऽ छेलै । चीन केरऽ विदेश मंत्री वांग यी केरऽ १८ अगस्त २०२५ क॑ भारत यात्रा के दौरान करलऽ गेलऽ १२ सूत्री समझौता म॑ लिपुलेख के माध्यम स॑ सीमा व्यापार शुरू करै के भी जिक्र करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

एहि संबंध मे नेपाल मे काफी विरोध भेल, आ सरकार दुनू देश कए कूटनीतिक नोट सेहो पठेलक । दुनू देश अपन प्रतिक्रिया पठौने अछि, मुदा विवाद जखन कि अनसुलझल अछि, व्यापारिक गतिविधि आगू बढ़ैत अछि।

Kathmandu, Aug 24: The House of Representatives (HoR) of the Federal Parliament is scheduled to meet today at 1:00 pm, where the relevant ministers will respond to the quires of lawmakers.

Finance Minister Dr. Swarnim Wagle, on behalf of the Prime Minister Balendra Shah, is anticipated to propose forwarding the First Amendment Bill, 2083, which addresses the remuneration and services of constitutional office bearers, to the appropriate committee for further examination.

Additionally, Foreign Minister Shishir Khanal will present a proposal to send the Passport (First Amendment) Bill, 2083, to the relevant committee for in-depth discussion.

Minister Sita Badi will also propose that the Human Trafficking and Transportation (Control) (First Amendment) Bill, 2083, be sent for further deliberation, while Minister Gauri Kumari is expected to propose sending the Mines and Minerals Bill, 2083, to the relevant committee.

Meanwhile, five parliamentary committees are meeting today: International Relations and Tourism, Agriculture and Natural Resources, Infrastructure Development, Legislative Management, and Public Policy and Delegated Legislation.(RSS)

title: 'His feet are his pillars': Nepal para swimmer gives all for Asian glory - Yahoo Sports
description: 'His feet are his pillars': Nepal para swimmer gives all for Asian glory  Yahoo Sports
publisher.title: Yahoo Sports
full_article:
Every morning Harka Man Gharti slices into the blue water of a swimming pool in Nepal's capital Kathmandu, chasing a dream that stretches far beyond its 25 metres.

Unlike the swimmers around him who rely on long strokes of their arms, Gharti powers through his legs and torso because he does not have arms.

The 21-year-old is training with three other disabled swimmers who will represent Nepal in the Asian Para Games in Japan in October, chasing medals despite limited resources in the Himalayan country.

"It is not my hope, it is my target," Gharti told AFP after finishing a gruelling session. "Just for a medal, I am giving everything... every possible thing."

A decade ago an electrocution accident near a hydroelectric project in his native Baglung district in western Nepal changed his life forever, costing him both arms.

The tragedy that could have ended his ambitions instead helped forge his extraordinary determination.

What began as an experiment with competitive swimming in 2020 soon became a passion and a career pathway.

"I love everything about swimming, whether competitive or just for enjoying," he said.

At the hostel where he lives in Kathmandu a row of medals hangs above his bed, proof of a remarkable journey.

During training he concentrates on his technique and body position in the water. On race days a different instinct takes over.

"I don't really think about the techniques or my body alignment," he said. "I just go hard. I just push fast and I just want to push power. That's it. I just think about speed and for speed I just kick harder and harder."

- Leg power -

At last year's Para Swimming World Series in Japan, Gharti's times met the minimum qualifying standards for the Asian Para Games, earning him a chance to compete on one of the biggest sporting stages.

He will participate in the S5 classification, including the 50-metre freestyle.

China's Guo Jincheng holds the men's 50m freestyle record at 29.33 seconds in the category.

Sports facilities in Nepal are modest by international standards.

Para athletes in the country often face limited funding, scarce specialised infrastructure and a lack of competitive opportunities.

His coach, Subha Shrestha, believes Gharti's greatest strength lies not in what he has lost, but in what he has built.

"When we don't have even a single finger we feel the impact," Shrestha said. "But he is working so hard with no hands.

"His feet are his pillars, his legs are very powerful."

The wider significance of Gharti's quest is not lost on Nepal's para swimming community.

The nation has had only one Asian Para Games medallist, taekwondo athlete Palesha Goverdhan, who won bronze last time out before also claiming a medal in Paralympics.

For many years Nepali athletes have arrived at major competitions with modest expectations.

"In Nepal they often say that we go only for the sake of participation," said Saroj Shrestha, president of the National Para Swimming Association of Nepal.

"But Harka and we both dream to do something in swimming that even able-bodied athletes have not been able to achieve."

- Inspiring others -

Back on the pool deck, Gharti's ambitions extend beyond sport.

Having recently completed high school, he plans to study computer science.

He navigates a computer with his toes, displaying the same determination that has become central to his swimming.

"Swimming is a platform for me where it is on me whether I can make my life better or not.

"Because if I hit a world record then of course my life will be better," he said.

"Only then can I speak of inspiring anyone else."

हरका मन घरती नेपाल के राजधानी काठमांडू के एकटा स्विमिंग पूल के नील रंग के पानि में टुकड़ा-टुकड़ा करैत अपन 25 मीटर स बहुत आगू तक पसरल सपना के पीछा करैत छथि।

अपनऽ आसपास के तैराकऽ के विपरीत जे अपनऽ बांह के लम्बा स्ट्रोक पर निर्भर रहै छै, घरती अपनऽ टांग आरू धड़ के माध्यम स॑ शक्ति दै छै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरा पास हाथ नै छै ।

Kathmandu, August 24

Nepal imported paddy and rice worth nearly Rs 1.8 billion in the first month of the current fiscal year 2082/83 BS.

According to data from the Department of Customs, Nepal imported 24,939 tonnes of paddy and rice worth Rs 1.78 billion in Shrawan, the first month of the fiscal year. The imports amounted to 24.94 million kilograms. Paddy and rice imports declined compared to the same month last fiscal year. In Shrawan of fiscal year 2081/82 BS, Nepal imported 57,083 tonnes of paddy and rice worth Rs 2.93 billion.

The data shows a decline in both the volume of imports and the amount spent on them during the first month of the current fiscal year compared to the corresponding period last year. A breakdown of the imports shows that the largest amount was spent on rice. In Shrawan, Nepal imported 11,852 tonnes of rice worth Rs 833.32 million. Almost the entire quantity—11,851 tonnes—was imported from neighbouring India, while a negligible 0.24 tonnes (240 kg) came from Italy.

Basmati rice ranked second in terms of import value. Nepal imported 4,125 tonnes of Basmati rice worth Rs 568.59 million in Shrawan, all of which came from India. In addition to milled rice, Nepal also imports a significant quantity of unmilled paddy. In the first month of the current fiscal year, 8,628 tonnes of paddy worth Rs 365.02 million were imported, all from India.

Similarly, Nepal spent millions of rupees importing broken rice. In Shrawan alone, 332 tonnes of broken rice worth Rs 13.31 million were imported from India. The customs data also shows that small quantities of brown rice and paddy seeds were imported, in addition to the larger volumes of paddy, rice and broken rice.

Nepal imported 625 kg of brown rice worth Rs 89,000 in Shrawan, of which 500 kg came from Thailand and 125 kg from India. Likewise, 67 kg of paddy seeds worth Rs 501,000 were imported during the first month of the current fiscal year. More paddy seeds were imported from China than from India.

In Brief:

Tiger population up 73% in Parsa, from 41 in 2022 to 71 in 2026

Park begins CA|TS certification process to strengthen conservation

Workshop held with officials, partners, security agencies and communities

Focus on habitat, prey, anti-poaching, coexistence and long-term safety

Parsa National Park's tiger population has risen by nearly 73 per cent in four years, prompting the park to begin a process to bring its conservation management in line with international standards.

The number of adult tigers in the park increased from 41 in 2022 to 71 in the 2026 census. Authorities have now initiated the Conservation Assured | Tiger Standards (CA|TS) certification process to turn the population gain into long-term and quality conservation.

A CA|TS workshop organised by the Department of National Parks and Wildlife Conservation was recently held at Parsa, bringing together officials, conservation partners, security agencies, park staff, buffer-zone representatives and local stakeholders.

Park Chief Conservation Officer Ram Chandra Khatiwada said the workshop discussed initial preparations, self-assessment, management improvements, evidence collection and coordination among stakeholders.

Senior ecologist Haribhadhra Acharya said the rise in tiger numbers alone was not enough to ensure long-term conservation.

He said sustained improvement in habitat, prey availability, security and overall management was necessary, adding that CA|TS would assess the broader conservation management system against international standards rather than simply counting tigers.

Khatiwada said the increase in tiger numbers was an important conservation achievement, but the park now faced the challenge of keeping both tigers and local communities safe.

He said the park's 'Tiger Friend Campaign' could be linked with the CA|TS process to strengthen awareness, community participation and human-tiger coexistence.

The certification process will assess habitat and prey protection, anti-poaching measures, smart patrolling, scientific monitoring, community participation, human-tiger conflict, tourism and the long-term status of tigers.

The process will involve registration, self-assessment, preparation of improvement plans and compliance documents, national review, independent assessment and an international decision.

Stakeholders at the workshop stressed that CA|TS should not be treated merely as a process to obtain certification, but as a joint initiative involving the park, buffer-zone communities, security agencies, conservation partners and local residents.

Authorities expect the process to make Parsa's conservation management more scientific, systematic and consistent with international standards. Khatiwada said the ultimate measure of conservation success would be tigers remaining safe, forests remaining healthy and local communities becoming secure and active partners in conservation, rather than the certificate itself.

वरिष्ठ पारिस्थितिकीविद हरिभध्र आचार्य कहलनि जे, बाघक संख्या मे वृद्धि मात्र दीर्घकालीन संरक्षण सुनिश्चित करबा लेल पर्याप्त नहि अछि।

हुनी कहलकै कि आवास, शिकार के उपलब्धता, सुरक्षा आरू समग्र प्रबंधन मँ लगातार सुधार जरूरी छै, आरू कहलकै कि सीए|टीएस व्यापक संरक्षण प्रबंधन प्रणाली के आकलन खाली बाघ के गिनती नै करी क अंतरराष्ट्रीय मानक के खिलाफ करतै ।

खतीवाड़ा नँ कहलकै कि बाघ के संख्या मँ वृद्धि संरक्षण केरौ एगो महत्वपूर्ण उपलब्धि छेकै, लेकिन पार्क मँ अब॑ बाघ आरू स्थानीय समुदाय दूनू क॑ सुरक्षित रखै के चुनौती छै ।

हुनी कहलकै कि पार्क केरौ ‘टाइगर फ्रेंड कैंपेन’ क सीए|टीएस प्रक्रिया स॑ जोड़लऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ताकि जागरूकता, समुदाय के भागीदारी आरू मानव-बाघ के सह-अस्तित्व क॑ मजबूत करलऽ जाय सक॑ ।

प्रमाणीकरण प्रक्रिया मे आवास आ शिकार संरक्षण, शिकार विरोधी उपाय, स्मार्ट गश्त, वैज्ञानिक निगरानी, ​​समुदायक भागीदारी, मानव-बाघ संघर्ष, पर्यटन आ बाघक दीर्घकालीन स्थितिक आकलन कैल जाएत।

एहि प्रक्रिया मे पंजीकरण, आत्म-मूल्यांकन, सुधार योजना आ अनुपालन दस्तावेज तैयार करब, राष्ट्रीय समीक्षा, स्वतंत्र आकलन आ अंतर्राष्ट्रीय निर्णय शामिल होयत।

कार्यशाला मे हितधारक कें जोर देल गेलय कि सीए|टीएस कें केवल प्रमाणीकरण प्राप्त करय कें प्रक्रिया कें रूप मे नहि मानल जैबाक चाही, बल्कि पार्क, बफर-जोन समुदाय, सुरक्षा एजेंसी, संरक्षण भागीदार आ स्थानीय निवासीक कें शामिल करय वाला संयुक्त पहल कें रूप मे मानल जेबाक चाही.

अधिकारी सब के उम्मीद छै कि ई प्रक्रिया स॑ पर्सा के संरक्षण प्रबंधन क॑ अधिक वैज्ञानिक, व्यवस्थित आरू अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मानक के अनुरूप बनैलऽ जैतै । खतीवाड़ा नँ कहलकै कि संरक्षण सफलता के अंतिम पैमाना बाघ के सुरक्षित रहना, जंगल स्वस्थ रहना आरू स्थानीय समुदाय संरक्षण मँ सुरक्षित आरू सक्रिय भागीदार बनना होतै, नै कि खुद प्रमाणपत्र ।

title: 'His feet are his pillars': Nepal para swimmer gives all for Asian glory - Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)
description: 'His feet are his pillars': Nepal para swimmer gives all for Asian glory  Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)
publisher.title: Bangladesh Sangbad Sangstha (BSS)

KATHMANDU, Nepal, Aug 24, 2026 (BSS/AFP) - Every morning Harka Man Gharti slices into the blue water of a swimming pool in Nepal's capital Kathmandu, chasing a dream that stretches far beyond its 25 metres.

Unlike the swimmers around him who rely on long strokes of their arms, Gharti powers through his legs and torso because he does not have arms.

The 21-year-old is training with three other disabled swimmers who will represent Nepal in the Asian Para Games in Japan in October, chasing medals despite limited resources in the Himalayan country.

"It is not my hope, it is my target," Gharti told AFP after finishing a gruelling session. "Just for a medal, I am giving everything... every possible thing."

A decade ago an electrocution accident near a hydroelectric project in his native Baglung district in western Nepal changed his life forever, costing him both arms.

The tragedy that could have ended his ambitions instead helped forge his extraordinary determination.

What began as an experiment with competitive swimming in 2020 soon became a passion and a career pathway.

"I love everything about swimming, whether competitive or just for enjoying," he said.

At the hostel where he lives in Kathmandu a row of medals hangs above his bed, proof of a remarkable journey.

During training he concentrates on his technique and body position in the water. On race days a different instinct takes over.

"I don't really think about the techniques or my body alignment," he said. "I just go hard. I just push fast and I just want to push power. That's it. I just think about speed and for speed I just kick harder and harder."

- Leg power -

At last year's Para Swimming World Series in Japan, Gharti's times met the minimum qualifying standards for the Asian Para Games, earning him a chance to compete on one of the biggest sporting stages.

He will participate in the S5 classification, including the 50-metre freestyle.

China's Guo Jincheng holds the men's 50m freestyle record at 29.33 seconds in the category.

Sports facilities in Nepal are modest by international standards.

Para athletes in the country often face limited funding, scarce specialised infrastructure and a lack of competitive opportunities.

His coach, Subha Shrestha, believes Gharti's greatest strength lies not in what he has lost, but in what he has built.

"When we don't have even a single finger we feel the impact," Shrestha said. "But he is working so hard with no hands.

"His feet are his pillars, his legs are very powerful."

The wider significance of Gharti's quest is not lost on Nepal's para swimming community.

The nation has had only one Asian Para Games medallist, taekwondo athlete Palesha Goverdhan, who won bronze last time out before also claiming a medal in Paralympics.

For many years Nepali athletes have arrived at major competitions with modest expectations.

"In Nepal they often say that we go only for the sake of participation," said Saroj Shrestha, president of the National Para Swimming Association of Nepal.

"But Harka and we both dream to do something in swimming that even able-bodied athletes have not been able to achieve."

- Inspiring others -

Back on the pool deck, Gharti's ambitions extend beyond sport.

Having recently completed high school, he plans to study computer science.

He navigates a computer with his toes, displaying the same determination that has become central to his swimming.

"Swimming is a platform for me where it is on me whether I can make my life better or not.

"Because if I hit a world record then of course my life will be better," he said.

"Only then can I speak of inspiring anyone else."

काठमाण्डू, नेपाल, २४ अगस्त २०२६ (वि.स./ए.एफ.पी.) - हरका मन घरती नेपालके राजधानी काठमाण्डौके स्विमिंग पूलके नीला पानिमे चीर-फाड़ करैत अपन २५ मीटरसँ बहुत आगू पसरल सपनाके पीछा करैत अछि ।

अपनऽ आसपास के तैराकऽ के विपरीत जे अपनऽ बांह के लम्बा स्ट्रोक पर निर्भर रहै छै, घरती अपनऽ टांग आरू धड़ के माध्यम स॑ शक्ति दै छै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरा पास हाथ नै छै ।

21 वर्षीय खिलाड़ी हिमालयी देश मे सीमित संसाधन रहितो पदकक पीछा करैत अक्टूबर मे जापान मे होबय बला एशियन पैरा गेम्स मे नेपालक प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला तीन अन्य दिव्यांग तैराक के संग प्रशिक्षण ल रहल छथिन्ह.

एकटा थकाऊ सत्र समाप्त केलाक बाद घरती एएफपी स कहलथि जे इ हमर उम्मीद नहि अछि, इ हमर निशाना अछि। "बस मेडल लेल हम सब किछु द' रहल छी... हर संभव चीज."

एक दशक पहिने पश्चिम नेपाल के हुनकर पैतृक बागलुंग जिला के जलविद्युत परियोजना के पास बिजली के दुर्घटना के कारण हुनकर जीवन हमेशा के लेल बदलि गेल छल, जाहि सं हुनकर दुनु हाथ के नुकसान भ गेल छल.

जे त्रासदी ओकर बदला मे ओकर महत्वाकांक्षा के समाप्त क सकैत छल, ओकर असाधारण संकल्प के गढ़बा मे मदद केलक।

जे 2020 में प्रतिस्पर्धी तैराकी के प्रयोग के रूप में शुरू भेल छल ओ जल्दिये एकटा पैशन आ कैरियर के मार्ग बनि गेल।

ओ कहला जे हमरा तैराकी क सब किछु नीक लगैत अछि, चाहे ओ प्रतिस्पर्धी हो या सिर्फ आनंद लेबा लेल।

काठमांडू मे जाहि हॉस्टल मे ओ रहैत छथि ओहि मे हुनकर पलंग क ऊपर पदक क पंक्ति लटकल अछि जे एकटा उल्लेखनीय यात्रा क प्रमाण अछि ।

प्रशिक्षण के दौरान ओ अपन तकनीक आ पानि मे शरीर के स्थिति पर ध्यान केंद्रित करैत छथि । दौड़क दिन एकटा अलग वृत्ति अपन कब्जा जमा लैत अछि ।

ओ कहलनि जे, हम वास्तव मे तकनीक या अपन शरीर के संरेखण के बारे मे नहि सोचैत छी। "हम त' बस जोर सँ जाइत छी. हम त' बस तेजी सँ धक्का दैत छी आओर हम बस पावर केँ धक्का देब' चाहैत छी. एतबे। हम त' बस गति'क बारे मे सोचैत छी आओर गति'क लेल हम बस जोर सँ आओर जोर सँ लात मारैत छी."

- पैर शक्ति - 10।

पिछला साल जापान म॑ आयोजित पैरा तैराकी वर्ल्ड सीरीज म॑ घरती केरऽ समय एशियाई पैरा गेम्स लेली न्यूनतम क्वालीफाइंग मानक क॑ पूरा करी क॑ हुनका एगो बड़ऽ खेल मंच प॑ प्रतिस्पर्धा करै के मौका मिललै ।

ओ 50 मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल सहित एस 5 वर्गीकरण मे भाग लेताह।

चीन केरऽ गुओ जिनचेंग केरऽ पुरुष ५० मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल केरऽ रिकॉर्ड २९.३३ सेकंड के साथ छै ।

नेपालमे खेलक सुविधा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मानकसँ मामूली अछि ।

देश म॑ पैरा एथलीटऽ क॑ अक्सर सीमित फंडिंग, दुर्लभ विशेष बुनियादी ढाँचा आरू प्रतिस्पर्धी अवसरऽ के कमी के सामना करना पड़ै छै ।

हुनकऽ कोच सुभा श्रेष्ठ के मानना ​​छै कि घरती केरऽ सबस॑ बड़ऽ ताकत वू चीज म॑ नै छै, बल्कि ओकरऽ निर्माण म॑ छै ।

श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, जखन हमरा सब लग एको आँगुर तक नहि रहैत अछि त एकर असर महसूस होइत अछि। "मुदा ओ एतेक मेहनति क' रहल छथि जे हाथ नहि अछि."

"पएर ओकर खंभा छै, टांग बहुत शक्तिशाली छै।"

घरती के खोज के व्यापक महत्व नेपाल के पैरा तैराकी समुदाय पर नै हेराय छै ।

राष्ट्र के पास एशियाई पैरा गेम्स केरऽ खाली एगो पदक विजेता ताइक्वांडो एथलीट पलेशा गोवर्धन रहलऽ छै, जे पैरालिम्पिक म॑ भी पदक प॑ दावा करै स॑ पहल॑ पिछला बार आउट होय क॑ कांस्य पदक जीतल॑ छेलै ।

कतेको वर्ष सँ नेपाली एथलीट मामूली अपेक्षाक संग पैघ प्रतियोगिता मे पहुँचैत छथि ।

नेपालक राष्ट्रिय पारा तैराकी संघके अध्यक्ष सरोज श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, नेपालमे ओ सब प्रायः कहैत छथि जे हम सब मात्र सहभागिता लेल जाइत छी ।

"मुदा हरका आरू हम्में दोनों के सपना छै कि तैराकी में कुछ ऐसनऽ करलौ जाय जेकरा सक्षम एथलीट भी नै हासिल करी सकलऽ छै।"

- दोसरो के प्रेरित करब -

पूल डेक पर वापसी मे घरती क महत्वाकांक्षा खेल स आगू बढ़ि गेल अछि।

हालहि मे हाई स्कूल पूरा केलाक बाद हुनकर योजना कंप्यूटर साइंस के पढ़ाई करय के अछि.

ओ अपन पैरक आँगुरसँ कंप्यूटरकेँ नेविगेट करैत छथि , ओहि दृढ़ संकल्पकेँ प्रदर्शित करैत छथि जे हुनकर हेलबामे केंद्रीय बनि गेल अछि ।

"तैराकी हमरा लेल एकटा एहन मंच अछि जतय ई हमरा पर अछि जे हम अपन जीवन केँ नीक बना सकब वा नहि।"

ओ कहलनि जे, कारण जौं हम विश्व रिकॉर्ड बना लेब तखन बेशक हमर जीवन नीक भ जायत।

"तखनहि हम ककरो आन केँ प्रेरित करबाक गप्प क' सकब।"

title: NDTV World to hold India-Nepal dialogue in Kathmandu - The Kathmandu Post
description: NDTV World to hold India-Nepal dialogue in Kathmandu  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
NDTV World is set to launch “NDTV Anviksha: Ideas Across Borders”, a global conversation series aimed at creating a deeper understanding between countries by allowing them to articulate their own ideas, ambitions, anxieties and perspectives.

The inaugural edition, “The India-Nepal Dialogue”, will be held in Kathmandu on Thursday, bringing together political leaders, policymakers, diplomats, business leaders, strategic thinkers and cultural figures from Nepal and India.

Kantipur Media Group will be the Nepal media partner for the initiative, bringing together the reach of two major South Asian media organisations. Kantipur TV will broadcast the event to audiences in Nepal.

According to NDTV, the initiative seeks to move beyond familiar narratives and assumptions about countries by creating conversations rooted in inquiry, reflection and listening. The name Anviksha draws from the ancient Indian tradition of “anvīkṣikī”, which refers to the pursuit of understanding through reason, reflection and examination.

The series will travel across countries, placing a nation at the centre of each edition and examining its history, identity, lived realities and ambitions alongside broader geopolitical and economic developments.

The Nepal dialogue comes as the country undergoes political, economic and social changes while seeking to define its place in a changing Asian and global order. The discussions will explore Nepal’s economic ambitions, entrepreneurial activity, democratic evolution and the aspirations of its young population, as well as opportunities in technology, tourism, infrastructure, sustainability, trade and regional cooperation.

“भारत-नेपाल संवाद” बृहस्पतिदिन काठमाण्डौमे नेपाल आ भारतक राजनैतिक नेता, नीति निर्माता, राजनयिक, व्यापारिक नेता, सामरिक विचारक आ सांस्कृतिक हस्ती सभ एक ठाम आओत ।

कान्तिपुर मिडिया ग्रुप एहि पहल लेल नेपाल मीडिया पार्टनर होयत, जाहि मे दक्षिण एशिया के दूटा प्रमुख मीडिया संगठन के पहुंच के एक संग आओत. कान्तिपुर टीवी नेपाल मे दर्शक के बीच एहि आयोजन के प्रसारण करत.

एनडीटीवी के अनुसार ई पहल पूछताछ, चिंतन आरू सुनना म॑ जड़ जमाय क॑ बातचीत पैदा करी क॑ देशऽ के बारे म॑ परिचित कथ्य आरू धारणा स॑ आगू बढ़ै के कोशिश करै छै । अनविक्ष नाम प्राचीन भारतीय परंपरा “अन्वीक्षी” सँ लेल गेल अछि, जे तर्क, चिंतन आ परीक्षा के माध्यम सँ समझ के खोज के संदर्भित करैत अछि |

ई श्रृंखला देशऽ के यात्रा करतै, जेकरा म॑ हर संस्करण के केंद्र म॑ एगो राष्ट्र क॑ रखलऽ जैतै आरू एकरऽ इतिहास, पहचान, जीवित वास्तविकता आरू महत्वाकांक्षा के साथ-साथ व्यापक भू-राजनीतिक आरू आर्थिक विकास के जांच करलऽ जैतै ।

नेपाल केरऽ संवाद ऐन्हऽ समय म॑ आबी रहलऽ छै जब॑ देश म॑ बदलतऽ एशियाई आरू वैश्विक व्यवस्था म॑ अपनऽ स्थान परिभाषित करै के कोशिश करलऽ जाय रहलऽ छै । एहि चर्चा मे नेपालक आर्थिक महत्वाकांक्षा, उद्यमशीलताक गतिविधि, लोकतांत्रिक विकास आ ओकर युवा आबादी केर आकांक्षाक संग-संग प्रौद्योगिकी, पर्यटन, बुनियादी ढांचा, स्थायित्व, व्यापार आ क्षेत्रीय सहयोग मे अवसरक खोज होयत।

Kathmandu. Luxury Chinese electric vehicle brand 'Skywell' has entered Nepal. LRR Motors has brought the BE11 model electric vehicles of Skywell to Nepal.

title: Harka questions whether Nepal’s laws are weak or those enforcing them - Khabarhub
description: Harka questions whether Nepal’s laws are weak or those enforcing them  Khabarhub
publisher.title: Khabarhub
full_article:
KATHMANDU: Shram Sanskriti Party Chair Harkaraj Sampang has questioned whether Nepal’s laws are weak or the people responsible for enforcing them are incapable.

Speaking during the special session of the House of Representatives on Monday, Sampang questioned the effectiveness of Nepal’s legal system.

“Is our country’s law weak, or are the people enforcing the law?” Sampang asked. Comparing the situation to a vehicle, he questioned whether the problem lies with the vehicle itself or with the person unable to drive it properly.

Sampang also expressed anger over the government’s inability to bring home the bodies of Nepali migrant workers who die abroad.

He said Nepal had even been unable to recover money allegedly kept in Swiss banks, while families of Nepali migrant workers faced difficulties bringing the bodies of their loved ones back home.

Sampang said criminals were walking around as if they carried the law in their pockets, stressing that people must have fear and respect for the law.

He also called for severe punishment for those convicted of rape and murder of minor girls.

“Minor girls are being raped and murdered. Once a person is proven to be a rapist, they should be punished severely,” Sampang said.

The rape and murder of a three-year-old girl has sparked outrage across Nepal, with demands growing for a swift investigation and tougher laws.

The child went missing from her home in Bara, almost 127km from the capital Kathmandu in Madhesh province, on 16 August. Her mutilated and decomposed body was found at a nearby abandoned house three days later after neighbours reported a smell.

Police said a 24-year-old driver and a 17-year-old helper on a bus were among the suspects arrested in connection with the case.

description: Fall Season Starts On Manaslu  Explorersweb »
publisher.title: Explorersweb »
full_article:
The fall season in Nepal has begun, and Manaslu is the most popular ascent.

The Expedition Operators’ Association of Nepal (EOA) has formed a team of Sherpa climbers to fix the ropes. The seven-member team, led by Chhiring Bhote, will depart to the base of the mountain tomorrow. Lopsang Bhote, Ngima Sherpa, Pam Dorjee Sherpa, Furi Sherpa, Pasang Gyaljen Sherpa, and Karma Sarki Sherpa will fix the ropes to the summit and plant a Nepal flag on top.

Meanwhile, commercial expedition companies are rushing to set up the huge base camp and will soon start building Camp 1 on a large snowy plain.

Some images of staff setting up Base Camp on Manaslu. Photo: Satori Adventures

An essential task

These days, professional Sherpa teams fix the normal routes on Nepal’s 8,000’ers from bottom to top, and then everyone else on the mountain follows. Therefore, the rope-fixing work marks progress on the mountains. There are rare exceptions, odd teams of self-sufficient climbers who climb in off-season. On Manaslu, all commercial expeditions climb in September and October.

Alex Moroz of Ukraine and Mark Ablovacky of Russia climbed Manaslu in spring this year, and had the mountain all to themselves. This marked a rare alpine approach with no supplementary oxygen or support.

Climbers go up fixed ropes on Manaslu in 2022. Photo: World Sherpas/Furtemba Sherpa

With modern commercial methods, expedition duration is cut in half. Last year, the rope-fixers achieved the first summits of the season on September 21. By October 2, the mountain had closed with over 600 summits. That left enough time for local guides and support staff, as well as some climbers, to move to other mountains.

Slightly fewer permits expected

According to data from Nepal’s Department of Tourism (DoT), the final summit tally for Manaslu in 2025 was 659, including both foreigners and locals. It is worth noting that some Sherpa guides reached the summit more than once. For the upcoming season, sources at the DoT estimate they will grant around 300 permits to international climbers. If their estimate is reasonably accurate, that means a decrease from 2025, when they granted 381 permits.

The huge 2024 Manaslu Base Camp. Photo: Seven Summit Treks

Things may change in the next few weeks. Manaslu could attract some of the climbers who had planned to climb Cho Oyu or Shisha Pangma, after the China-Tibet Mountaineering Association confirmed they will ban foreign expeditions on the two Tibetan 8,000’ers.

Pakistan vs. Nepal

There might also be some last-minute additions from climbers who attempted 8,000’ers in Pakistan. The Pakistan summer season has seen few summits because of bad weather. The season ended abruptly when an avalanche killed ten climbers on Broad Peak on July 30. It is the first time since the COVID pandemic in 2020 that no one has summited K2. The few teams on the mountain aborted their summit push after the terrible news from neighboring Broad Peak.

Lukas Supergan of Poland was one of the first climbers to announce their plans for Manaslu. He will attempt the mountain without using supplemental oxygen or Sherpa support.

Supergan had been pondering whether to climb in Nepal or Pakistan this year. In 2025, he was the last climber to retreat from Broad Peak because of bad conditions on the route. This year, he feared finding the same problems on Broad Peak and eventually chose to climb Manaslu in September. “The events of this summer showed that giving up on Pakistan was the right decision,” Supergan wrote on social media.

एकटा आवश्यक काज

कनि कम परमिट के उम्मीद अछि

नेपाल के पर्यटन विभाग के आंकड़ा के अनुसार 2025 में मनसलू के लेल अंतिम शिखर सम्मेलन 659 छल, जाहि में विदेशी आ स्थानीय दुनु शामिल छल. ध्यान देबय योग्य बात ई जे किछु शेर्पा गाइड एक सं बेसी बेर शिखर पर पहुंचल छलाह. आबै वाला सीजन लेली डॉट केरऽ सूत्रऽ के अनुमान छै कि वू अंतरराष्ट्रीय पर्वतारोही सिनी क॑ लगभग ३०० परमिट देतै । अगर हुनकऽ अनुमान यथोचित रूप स॑ सही छै त॑ एकरऽ मतलब छै कि २०२५ स॑ कमी, जब॑ हुनी ३८१ परमिट देल॑ छेलै ।

पाकिस्तान बनाम नेपाल

पाकिस्तान में 8000’ers के प्रयास करय वाला पर्वतारोही के अंतिम समय में किछ जोड़ सेहो भ सकैत अछि. पाकिस्तान के गर्मी के मौसम में खराब मौसम के कारण शिखर सम्मेलन कम देखल गेल अछि. मौसम अचानक समाप्त भ गेल जखन 30 जुलाई कए ब्रॉड पीक पर हिमस्खलन मे दसटा पर्वतारोही क मौत भ गेल।2020 मे कोविड महामारी क बाद इ पहिल बेर अछि जे के2 क शिखर पर कियो नहि पहुंचल अछि। पहाड़ पर किछु टीम पड़ोसी ब्रॉड पीक सं आयल भयानक खबर के बाद अपन शिखर धक्का के गर्भपात क देलक.

पोलैंड केरऽ लुकास सुपरगन मनसलू लेली अपनऽ योजना के घोषणा करै वाला पहिलऽ पर्वतारोही म॑ स॑ एक छेलै । ओ बिना पूरक ऑक्सीजन या शेर्पा सपोर्ट के प्रयोग केने पहाड़ के प्रयास करताह।

full_article:
Popular Nepali comedy duo Sitaram Kattel, known as Dhurmus, and Kunjana Ghimire, known as Suntali, have produced a new comedy series in the United States.

The series, produced around Raleigh, North Carolina, focuses on the lives, experiences and challenges of Nepalis living in the United States. It is produced under Dhurmus-Suntali Media and will stream every Friday on the Dhurmus Suntali YouTube channel.

The program is scheduled to air at 8:15 p.m. Nepal time every Friday, while viewers in the United States can watch it at 10:30 a.m. Friday.

Filmed Across North Carolina

Kattel, who directed the series, said filming took place in Raleigh, Cary, Holly Springs, High Point and Greensboro, North Carolina.

The title comes from one of Dhurmus’ popular catchphrases from his earlier comedy work. Kattel and Ghimire will reprise their signature characters, Dhurmus and Suntali.

Senior comedian Mohan Mishra also appears in a leading role. Mishra, known as an actor and director for popular comedy programs including Hosh Prasad and Mr. Funtus , is returning to acting after a long break.

Cast and Crew

The cast includes Dinesh Karki, Shankar Raj Wagle, Sanyam Lamichhane, Monika Chaulagai, Chuda Dhimal, Dharma Bharati and Subhadra Acharya.

The series also marks the acting debut of Kattel and Ghimire’s daughter, Subihani Kattel, as a child performer. Veteran Nepali film actor Jeevan Luitel, who lives in the United States, will make a guest appearance after a lengthy break from the screen.

Raju KC handled cinematography. Ashish Aviral provided vocals, Prakash Punj wrote the lyrics, Rajendra Bajgai composed the music and Rajendra Manandhar edited the series.

Filming of the new Dhurmus-Suntali comedy series takes place in the Raleigh area of North Carolina.

Focus on Nepali Diaspora Life

The production team said the series will go beyond entertainment, using comedy and satire to portray the realities of Nepali immigrant life in the United States.

The story explores Nepalis’ struggles, opportunities, achievements and daily experiences abroad, as well as the Nepali community’s social and cultural environment. It addresses language barriers, cultural adjustment, work and business experiences, family relationships, the views of younger generations and efforts to preserve Nepali identity.

Madhav Dhakal, a former Nepali film producer and businessman based in High Point, North Carolina, praised the pair for pursuing regular creative work while living abroad.

“Starting regular artistic work from abroad is itself commendable,” Dhakal said. “It is not an ordinary matter for Sitaram ji to continue in this field. We will all provide our support and cooperation.”

Since moving to the United States, Kattel and Ghimire have remained active in media production, producing advertisements for about a dozen Nepali businesses and organizations. Kattel said additional advertisements and music videos are currently being filmed and produced.

“Our viewers will now be able to watch our serial regularly,” Kattel said. “Wherever we live, we want to convey the message that we can continue our art and creative work.”

नेपयॉर्क कें मुफ्त मे सब्सक्राइब करू आब, अहां यू.एस.वीजा, ग्रीन कार्ड, आ सब आप्रवासन समाचारक कें कोनों अपडेट कें संग-संग आवास, कर, स्वास्थ्य देखभाल, आ बहुत किछु पर आवश्यक जानकारी आ संसाधनक कें सेहो छूटि नहिं जायब. एकरा सब के सीधा अपन इनबॉक्स में पहुंचा दियौ। ईमेल पता एतय दर्ज करू... सब्सक्राइब करय लेल एतय क्लिक करू

ई शीर्षक धुर्मुस केरऽ एगो लोकप्रिय कैचफ्रेज स॑ मिललऽ छै जे हुनकऽ पहिने के हास्य कृति स॑ छै । कट्टल आ घिमिरे अपन सिग्नेचर किरदार धुर्मुस आ सुनतली कए दोबारा प्रस्तुत करताह ।

वरिष्ठ हास्य अभिनेता मोहन मिश्रा सेहो अग्रणी भूमिका मे अबैत छथि । होश प्रसाद आ मिस्टर फंटस सहित लोकप्रिय हास्य कार्यक्रम के अभिनेता आ निर्देशक के रूप में जानल जाय वाला मिश्रा बहुत दिन के ब्रेक के बाद अभिनय में वापसी क रहल छैथ।

कलाकार आ चालक दल

कलाकार मे दिनेश कार्की, शंकर राज वागले, संयाम लामिछाने, मोनिका चौलागाई, चूड़ा धीमाल, धर्म भारती आ सुभद्रा आचार्य शामिल छथि ।

ई धारावाहिक म॑ कटेल आरू घिमिरे केरऽ बेटी सुबिहानी कटेल केरऽ अभिनय केरऽ शुरुआत भी बाल कलाकार के रूप म॑ करलऽ गेलऽ छै । अमेरिका मे रहनिहार नेपाली फिल्मक दिग्गज अभिनेता जीवन लुइटेल पर्दा सँ लंबा समय धरि विरामक बाद अतिथिक रूप मे नजरि आओताह ।

राजू केसी छायांकन संभालने छलाह। आशीष अविराल स्वर प्रदान केलनि, प्रकाश पुंज गीत लिखलनि, राजेन्द्र बाजगाई संगीतक रचना केलनि आ राजेन्द्र मानन्धर एहि धारावाहिकक संपादन केलनि ।

धुर्मुस-सुंताली केरऽ नयका कॉमेडी सीरीज केरऽ फिल्मांकन नॉर्थ कैरोलिना केरऽ रेले इलाका म॑ होय रहलऽ छै ।

नेपाली प्रवासी जीवन पर ध्यान देब

निर्माण टीम के कहनाय छनि जे ई धारावाहिक मनोरंजन सं आगू बढ़ि क' अमेरिका मे नेपाली आप्रवासी जीवन के यथार्थ के चित्रण करय लेल हास्य आ व्यंग्य के प्रयोग करत.

कथा मे विदेश मे नेपाली लोकनिक संघर्ष, अवसर, उपलब्धि आ दैनिक अनुभवक संग-संग नेपाली समुदायक सामाजिक आ सांस्कृतिक परिवेशक खोज कयल गेल अछि । एहि मे भाषाक बाधा, सांस्कृतिक समायोजन, कार्य आ व्यवसायिक अनुभव, पारिवारिक संबंध, नव पीढ़ीक विचार आ नेपाली पहिचानक संरक्षणक प्रयास केँ संबोधित कयल गेल अछि ।

नॉर्थ कैरोलिना के हाई प्वाइंट में रहय वाला पूर्व नेपाली फिल्म निर्माता आ व्यवसायी माधव ढकाल विदेश में रहैत नियमित रूप स रचनात्मक काज करय लेल एहि जोड़ी के प्रशंसा केलनि।

धकाल कहलनि जे, विदेश स नियमित कलात्मक काज शुरू करब अपने आप मे सराहनीय अछि। ओ कहलनि जे, सीताराम जी के लेल एहि क्षेत्र मे आगू बढ़ब कोनो साधारण बात नहि अछि, हम सब अपन सहयोग आ सहयोग देब।”

अमेरिका आबि गेलाक बाद सं कट्टल आ घिमिरे मीडिया निर्माण मे सक्रिय रहलाह, लगभग एक दर्जन नेपाली व्यवसाय आ संस्थाक विज्ञापनक निर्माण करैत छथि । कटेल कहलनि जे, एखन अतिरिक्त विज्ञापन आ म्यूजिक वीडियो के फिल्मांकन आ निर्माण भ रहल अछि।

कटेल कहला जे आब हमर दर्शक हमर धारावाहिक नियमित रूप स देख सकैत छथि। “हम सब जतय रहैत छी, ई संदेश देबय चाहैत छी जे हम सब अपन कला आ रचनात्मक काज के आगू बढ़ा सकैत छी।”

title: ‘His feet are his pillars’: Nepal para swimmer gives all for Asian glory - Kuwait Times
description: ‘His feet are his pillars’: Nepal para swimmer gives all for Asian glory  Kuwait Times
publisher.title: Kuwait Times
full_article:
Every morning Harka Man Gharti slices into the blue water of a swimming pool in Nepal’s capital Kathmandu, chasing a dream that stretches far beyond its 25 metres. Unlike the swimmers around him who rely on long strokes of their arms, Gharti powers through his legs and torso because he does not have arms.

The 21-year-old is training with three other disabled swimmers who will represent Nepal in the Asian Para Games in Japan in October, chasing medals despite limited resources in the Himalayan country. “It is not my hope, it is my target,” Gharti told AFP after finishing a gruelling session. “Just for a medal, I am giving everything... every possible thing.”

A decade ago an electrocution accident near a hydroelectric project in his native Baglung district in western Nepal changed his life forever, costing him both arms. The tragedy that could have ended his ambitions instead helped forge his extraordinary determination. What began as an experiment with competitive swimming in 2020 soon became a passion and a career pathway.

“I love everything about swimming, whether competitive or just for enjoying,” he said. At the hostel where he lives in Kathmandu a row of medals hangs above his bed, proof of a remarkable journey. During training he concentrates on his technique and body position in the water. On race days a different instinct takes over. “I don’t really think about the techniques or my body alignment,” he said. “I just go hard. I just push fast and I just want to push power. That’s it. I just think about speed and for speed I just kick harder and harder.”

Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti using his mouth to write at his residence in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti using his toes to draw at his residence in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmers Harka Man Gharti (right) and Member Singi Syangba taking a break during a training session in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmers Harka Man Gharti (left), Jenisha Kadayat (second left), Sirjana Sarki (second right) and Member Singi Syangba posing for a photograph during a training session in Kathmandu. --AFP photos Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti taking part in a training session in Kathmandu.

Leg power

At last year’s Para Swimming World Series in Japan, Gharti’s times met the minimum qualifying standards for the Asian Para Games, earning him a chance to compete on one of the biggest sporting stages. He will participate in the S5 classification, including the 50-metre freestyle. China’s Guo Jincheng holds the men’s 50m freestyle record at 29.33 seconds in the category. Sports facilities in Nepal are modest by international standards.

Para athletes in the country often face limited funding, scarce specialized infrastructure and a lack of competitive opportunities. His coach, Subha Shrestha, believes Gharti’s greatest strength lies not in what he has lost, but in what he has built. “When we don’t have even a single finger we feel the impact,” Shrestha said. “But he is working so hard with no hands.

Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti being assisted by his coach Subah Shrestha during a training session in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti resting at his residence in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti using his toes to operate mobile phone at his residence in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmers Harka Man Gharti (left) and Member Singi Syangba taking a break during a training session in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti swimming during a training session in Kathmandu. Nepalese para-swimmer Harka Man Gharti using his toes to brush teeth at his residence in Kathmandu.

“His feet are his pillars, his legs are very powerful.” The wider significance of Gharti’s quest is not lost on Nepal’s para swimming community. The nation has had only one Asian Para Games medallist, taekwondo athlete Palesha Goverdhan, who won bronze last time out before also claiming a medal in Paralympics. For many years Nepali athletes have arrived at major competitions with modest expectations.

“In Nepal they often say that we go only for the sake of participation,” said Saroj Shrestha, president of the National Para Swimming Association of Nepal. “But Harka and we both dream to do something in swimming that even able-bodied athletes have not been able to achieve.”

Inspiring others

Back on the pool deck, Gharti’s ambitions extend beyond sport. Having recently completed high school, he plans to study computer science. He navigates a computer with his toes, displaying the same determination that has become central to his swimming. “Swimming is a platform for me where it is on me whether I can make my life better or not. “Because if I hit a world record then of course my life will be better,” he said. “Only then can I speak of inspiring anyone else.” — AFP

हरका मन घरती सब दिन भोरे नेपाल के राजधानी काठमांडू के एकटा स्विमिंग पूल के नील रंग के पानि में टुकड़ा-टुकड़ा क’ क’ एकटा सपना के पीछा करैत छथि जे अपन 25 मीटर सं बहुत आगू धरि पसरल अछि. अपनऽ आसपास के तैराकऽ के विपरीत जे अपनऽ बांह के लम्बा स्ट्रोक पर निर्भर रहै छै, घरती अपनऽ टांग आरू धड़ के माध्यम स॑ शक्ति दै छै, कैन्हेंकि ओकरा पास हाथ नै छै ।

21 वर्षीय खिलाड़ी हिमालयी देश मे सीमित संसाधन रहितो पदकक पीछा करैत अक्टूबर मे जापान मे होबय बला एशियन पैरा गेम्स मे नेपालक प्रतिनिधित्व करय वाला तीन अन्य दिव्यांग तैराक के संग प्रशिक्षण ल रहल छथिन्ह. एकटा कठिन सत्र समाप्त केलाक बाद घरती एएफपी स कहलथि जे इ हमर उम्मीद नहि अछि, इ हमर निशाना अछि। “बस एकटा मेडल लेल हम सब किछु द’ रहल छी... हर संभव चीज।”

एक दशक पहिने पश्चिम नेपाल के हुनकर पैतृक बागलुंग जिला के जलविद्युत परियोजना के पास बिजली के दुर्घटना के कारण हुनकर जीवन हमेशा के लेल बदलि गेल छल, जाहि सं हुनकर दुनु हाथ के नुकसान भ गेल छल. जे त्रासदी ओकर बदला मे ओकर महत्वाकांक्षा के समाप्त क सकैत छल, ओकर असाधारण संकल्प के गढ़बा मे मदद केलक। जे 2020 में प्रतिस्पर्धी तैराकी के प्रयोग के रूप में शुरू भेल छल ओ जल्दिये एकटा पैशन आ कैरियर के मार्ग बनि गेल।

ओ कहला जे हमरा तैराकी क सब किछु नीक लगैत अछि, चाहे ओ प्रतिस्पर्धी हो या सिर्फ आनंद लेबा लेल। काठमांडू मे जाहि हॉस्टल मे ओ रहैत छथि ओहि मे हुनकर पलंग क ऊपर पदक क पंक्ति लटकल अछि जे एकटा उल्लेखनीय यात्रा क प्रमाण अछि । प्रशिक्षण के दौरान ओ अपन तकनीक आ पानि मे शरीर के स्थिति पर ध्यान केंद्रित करैत छथि । दौड़क दिन एकटा अलग वृत्ति अपन कब्जा जमा लैत अछि । ओ कहलनि जे, हम वास्तव मे तकनीक आ अपन शरीर के संरेखण के बारे मे नहि सोचैत छी. “हम त’ बस जोर स’ जाइत छी। हम बस तेजी स’ धक्का दैत छी आ बस पावर धक्का देब’ चाहैत छी। एतबे। हम बस गति के बारे मे सोचैत छी आ गति के लेल हम बस जोर स’ जोर स’ लात मारैत छी।”

नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती (बामा) काठमांडू स्थित अपन आवास पर पैरक उंगली के प्रयोग करैत भोजन करैत छथि । नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती काठमांडू स्थित अपन आवास पर अपन मुँह के प्रयोग क लिखैत छथि । नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती काठमांडू स्थित अपन आवास पर पैर के उंगली के उपयोग क चित्र बनाबय के काज करैत। काठमांडूमे प्रशिक्षण सत्रमे विराम लैत नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती (दाहिना) आ सदस्य सिंगी स्यांगबा । काठमांडू मे प्रशिक्षण सत्र मे फोटोग्राफ लेल पोज दैत नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती (बामा), जेनिशा कदायत (द्वितीय बामा), सिरजना सरकी (द्वितीय दाहिना) आ सदस्य सिंगी स्यांगबा । --एएफपी के फोटो काठमांडू मे प्रशिक्षण सत्र मे भाग लैत नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती।

पैर के शक्ति

पिछला साल जापान म॑ आयोजित पैरा स्विमिंग वर्ल्ड सीरीज म॑ घरती केरऽ समय एशियाई पैरा गेम्स लेली न्यूनतम क्वालीफाइंग मानक क॑ पूरा करलकै, जेकरा स॑ हुनका एगो बड़ऽ खेल मंच प॑ प्रतिस्पर्धा करै के मौका मिललै । ओ 50 मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल सहित एस 5 वर्गीकरण मे भाग लेताह। चीन केरऽ गुओ जिनचेंग के पास पुरुषऽ के ५० मीटर फ्रीस्टाइल रिकॉर्ड छै आरू ई श्रेणी म॑ २९.३३ सेकंड के समय छै । नेपालमे खेलक सुविधा अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय मानकसँ मामूली अछि ।

देश म॑ पैरा एथलीटऽ क॑ अक्सर सीमित फंडिंग, दुर्लभ विशेष बुनियादी ढाँचा आरू प्रतिस्पर्धी अवसरऽ के कमी के सामना करना पड़ै छै । हुनकऽ कोच सुभा श्रेष्ठ के मानना ​​छै कि घरती केरऽ सबस॑ बड़ऽ ताकत वू चीज म॑ नै छै, बल्कि ओकरऽ निर्माण म॑ छै । श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, जखन हमरा सब लग एको आँगुर तक नहि रहैत अछि त’ एकर असर महसूस होइत अछि। “मुदा ओ एतेक मेहनति क’ रहल छथि जे हाथ नहि अछि।

काठमांडूमे प्रशिक्षण सत्रमे अपन कोच सुबाह श्रेष्ठके सहयोगमे नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती । काठमांडू स्थित अपन आवास पर विश्राम करैत नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती। नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती काठमांडू स्थित अपन आवास पर पैर के उंगली के उपयोग क मोबाइल फोन चलाबैत छथि । काठमांडूमे प्रशिक्षण सत्रमे विराम लैत नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती (बामा) आ सदस्य सिंगी स्यांगबा । काठमांडू मे प्रशिक्षण सत्र मे नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती तैराकी। नेपाली पैरा तैराक हरका मन घरती काठमांडू स्थित अपन आवास पर पैरक उंगली के प्रयोग करैत दाँत ब्रश करैत ।

“पएर ओकर खंभा छै, टांग बहुत शक्तिशाली छै।” घरती केरऽ खोज केरऽ व्यापक महत्व नेपाल केरऽ पैरा तैराकी समुदाय प॑ नै खतम होय रहलऽ छै । राष्ट्र के पास एशियाई पैरा गेम्स केरऽ खाली एगो पदक विजेता ताइक्वांडो एथलीट पलेशा गोवर्धन रहलऽ छै, जे पैरालिम्पिक म॑ भी पदक प॑ दावा करै स॑ पहल॑ पिछला बार आउट होय क॑ कांस्य पदक जीतल॑ छेलै । कतेको वर्ष सँ नेपाली एथलीट मामूली अपेक्षाक संग पैघ प्रतियोगिता मे पहुँचैत छथि ।

नेपाल राष्ट्रिय पारा तैराकी संघके अध्यक्ष सरोज श्रेष्ठ कहलनि जे, नेपालमे ओ सब प्रायः कहैत छथि जे हम सब मात्र सहभागिता लेल जाइत छी । “मुदा हरका आरू हम दोनों के सपना छै कि तैराकी में कुछ ऐसनऽ करलऽ जाय जेकरा सक्षम एथलीट भी नै हासिल करी सकलऽ छै।”

दोसरो के प्रेरित करब

पूल डेक पर वापसी मे घरती के महत्वाकांक्षा खेल सं आगू बढ़ि गेल अछि. हालहि मे हाई स्कूल पूरा केलाक बाद हुनकर योजना कंप्यूटर साइंस के पढ़ाई करय के अछि. ओ अपन पैरक आँगुरसँ कंप्यूटरकेँ नेविगेट करैत छथि , ओहि दृढ़ संकल्पकेँ प्रदर्शित करैत छथि जे हुनकर हेलबामे केंद्रीय बनि गेल अछि । ओ कहला जे तैराकी हमरा लेल एकटा एहन मंच अछि जतय हमरा पर इ अछि जे हम अपन जीवन कए नीक बना सकब या नहि। ओ कहलनि जे, कारण जौं हम विश्व रिकॉर्ड बना लेब तखन बेशक हमर जीवन नीक भ जायत। “तखनहि हम ककरो आन केँ प्रेरित करबाक गप्प क’ सकैत छी।” — एएफपी

title: NTB brings 35 travel creators together to reshape Nepal’s tourism story - The Tourism Times
description: NTB brings 35 travel creators together to reshape Nepal’s tourism story  The Tourism Times
publisher.title: The Tourism Times
full_article:
KATHMANDU: The Nepal Tourism Board has brought together 35 travel video makers, vloggers and social media influencers to discuss how Nepal can promote its tourism more effectively and authentically in the digital age.

The interaction, organised by the NTB at the Ministry of Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation, focused on ways to present Nepal's destinations and experiences to wider international audiences through digital storytelling.

Minister for Culture, Tourism and Civil Aviation Khadak Raj Paudel, Nepal Tourism Board Chairman and Tourism Ministry Secretary Mukund Prasad Niraula, and NTB Officiating Chief Executive Officer Hikmat Singh Ayer attended the interaction.

Minister Paudel stressed the need to showcase the “real Nepal”, saying the country's tourism story should go beyond its mountains, landscapes and heritage to highlight its people, hospitality, culture, stories and everyday interactions that make visitors' experiences memorable.

NTB Officiating CEO Ayer welcomed the content creators and called for their continued support in promoting Nepal's destinations and tourism experiences to audiences around the world.

The creators shared their experiences and discussed challenges in promoting Nepal, including the need for stronger coordination among government agencies and stakeholders, better synchronisation of promotional efforts and more effective use of the tourism-related content already being produced.

The discussion also highlighted the changing nature of destination marketing, with participants stressing that tourism promotion increasingly depends on compelling and credible stories rather than conventional advertising alone.

The NTB said the interaction was aimed at strengthening collaboration with creators who are already travelling across Nepal, producing visual content and sharing their experiences with audiences at home and abroad.

काठमाण्डु, मिथिला मिरर: नेपाल पर्यटन बोर्ड 35 टा ट्रैवल वीडियो निर्माता, व्लॉगर आ सोशल मीडिया इन्फ्लुएंसर कए एक ठाम अनलक अछि जे नेपाल डिजिटल युग मे कोना अपन पर्यटन कए बेसी प्रभावी आ प्रामाणिक रूप स बढ़ावा द सकैत अछि।

संस्कृति, पर्यटन आ नागरिक उड्डयन मन्त्रालय मे एनटीबी द्वारा आयोजित ई बातचीत डिजिटल कथाक माध्यम सँ नेपालक गन्तव्य आ अनुभव केँ व्यापक अन्तर्राष्ट्रिय दर्शकक समक्ष प्रस्तुत करबाक उपाय पर केन्द्रित छल ।

संस्कृति, पर्यटन तथा नागरिक उड्डयन मन्त्री खडक राज पौडेल, नेपाल पर्यटन बोर्ड के अध्यक्ष आ पर्यटन मन्त्रालय के सचिव मुकुन्द प्रसाद निरौला, आ एनटीबी के पदाधिकारी मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी हिकमत सिंह आयर सहभागिता रहल छल ।

मंत्री पौडेल “असली नेपाल” के प्रदर्शन के आवश्यकता पर जोर दैत कहलनि जे, देश के पर्यटन कथा के अपन पहाड़, परिदृश्य आ धरोहर स आगू बढ़ि क अपन लोक, आतिथ्य, संस्कृति, कहानी आ रोजमर्रा के बातचीत के उजागर करबाक चाही जे आगंतुक के अनुभव के यादगार बनाबैत अछि।

एनटीबी केरऽ आधिकारिक सीईओ आयर न॑ सामग्री निर्माता सिनी के स्वागत करतें हुअ॑ नेपाल केरऽ गंतव्य आरू पर्यटन केरऽ अनुभव क॑ दुनिया भर के दर्शकऽ तलक पहुँचै म॑ लगातार सहयोग के आह्वान करलकै ।

निर्माता सब अपन अनुभव साझा करैत नेपाल के प्रचार प्रसार में चुनौती के चर्चा केलनि, जाहि में सरकारी एजेंसी आ सरोकारवाला के बीच मजबूत समन्वय, प्रचार प्रयास के बेहतर समन्वय आ पहिने स बनल पर्यटन स संबंधित सामग्री के अधिक प्रभावी उपयोग के आवश्यकता शामिल अछि।

चर्चा म॑ गंतव्य विपणन केरऽ बदलतऽ प्रकृति प॑ भी प्रकाश डाललऽ गेलै, जेकरा म॑ प्रतिभागी न॑ ई बात प॑ जोर देलकै कि पर्यटन केरऽ प्रचार-प्रसार केवल पारंपरिक विज्ञापन स॑ बेसी मजबूर करै वाला आरू विश्वसनीय कहानी प॑ तेजी स॑ निर्भर छै ।

एनटीबी न॑ कहलकै कि ई बातचीत के उद्देश्य पहल॑ स॑ ही नेपाल भर म॑ घूमी रहलऽ रचनाकारऽ के साथ सहयोग मजबूत करना, दृश्य सामग्री के निर्माण आरू देश-विदेश के दर्शकऽ के साथ अपनऽ अनुभव साझा करना छेलै ।

title: 3-yr-old’s rape-murder near Bihar border fuels death penalty debate in Nepal - The Times of India
description: 3-yr-old’s rape-murder near Bihar border fuels death penalty debate in Nepal  The Times of India
publisher.title: The Times of India
full_article:
The rape and murder of a three-year-old girl in Nepal sparked parliamentary demands for the death penalty



Catch the latest World News and Live updates. Download the TOI app.



NEW DELHI: The rape and murder of a three-year-old girl in Nepal’s Bara district, around 25km from Raxaul in Bihar, triggered demands for the death penalty in parliament after days of protests, even as the principal suspect is a 16-year-old boy who, if convicted, would be sentenced under Nepal’s juvenile justice law. Lawmakers sought constitutional changes to allow capital punishment for heinous crimes, while RSP law minister Sobita Gautam and home minister Sudan Gurung told parliament that the govt could not introduce it without first amending the Constitution.The girl disappeared from Jeetpur-Simara on Aug 16 and her body was recovered two days later from an abandoned house near her home, leading to demonstrations in Simara, Kathmandu and other parts of Nepal. Police identified her teen neighbour as the principal suspect and widened the investigation, taking nine people into custody amid questions over whether officers had responded quickly enough after the family reported her missing.The killing dominated parliament proceedings, with ruling Rastriya Swatantra Party (RSP) lawmaker Afsana Banu demanding an amendment to Article 16(2), which prohibits capital punishment, and calling for Nepal to reconsider its international commitments against the death penalty.“No international treaty or law can stand above citizens’ safety. Concern for the human rights of criminals cannot come at the cost of victims’ rights and justice,” she said, urging her govt to amend the Constitution to allow death penalty for heinous crimes.Other RSP lawmakers questioned whether the existing legal framework provided adequate punishment in such cases. Anushka Shrestha said, “A person should not escape severe punishment for a heinous crime merely because the perpetrator is a minor,” while arguing that punishment for rape needed review. Shraddha Kunwar raised a separate constitutional argument, asking whether parliament should focus only on the prohibition on death penalty or also ensure women’s constitutional right to live with dignity.Gautam, however, told parliament that Article 16(2) explicitly barred Nepal from making any law providing for capital punishment and pointed to the country's international human rights commitments. “No matter how intense public anger becomes, our govt cannot legislate beyond the Constitution,” she said. Nepal constitutionally abolished capital punishment in 1990 and retained the prohibition in its 2015 Constitution.The suspect’s age presents a separate legal issue even as lawmakers debate capital punishment. Under Nepal’s Children Act, 2018, anyone below 18 is dealt with under juvenile law, and an offender aged 16 to below 18 can receive two-thirds of the punishment prescribed for an adult. For adults, Nepal’s criminal law provides for imprisonment for the remainder of natural life for murder committed after rape, the maximum punishment available under the existing constitutional framework.Following days of protests, govt reached a three-point agreement with the victim’s family and formed a seven-member Garima Nyaya Sankalpa Samiti under law ministry, giving it seven days to recommend changes concerning sexual violence and offences against women and children.
